AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Daley和Green（2020）模型，研究信息逐步揭示对双边议价的影响，结合柠檬市场理论和信息经济学。
AI.method: 采用实验室实验方法，实施Daley和Green（2020）模型，在受控环境中观察信息逐步揭示对交易行为的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 信息揭示不提高交易效率；2. 但减少买方与低质量卖方交易时的损失可能性；3. 买方表现出"等待新闻"效应，犹豫立即成交，只在积累足够积极信号时才大幅调整报价；4. 知情卖方对新闻较不敏感，但等待他们认为可接受的报价。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了Daley和Green（2020）模型在实验环境中的适用性；2. 揭示了信息逐步揭示对议价行为的动态影响；3. 发现了"等待新闻"效应这一行为模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为市场设计者提供关于信息揭示时机和方式的启示；2. 帮助交易者理解信息逐步揭示环境中的策略行为；3. 对监管机构在信息披露政策制定方面有参考价值。

title: Gender Patterns in Relationship Dissolution: Evidence from The No Contact Club
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Gender Patterns in Relationship Dissolution: Evidence from The No Contact Club
detail.abstract: This study examines gender asymmetries in romantic relationship dissolution based on poll data from 158 members of The No Contact Club, an online support community focused on post-breakup recovery. Among respondents, 30% reported ending their relationship unilaterally. Of those, 87.5% identified as female, 12.5% as male. The results mirror long-standing sociological findings that women initiate a majority of breakups, potentially reflecting gendered differences in emotional agency, social support structures, and perceived romantic optionality. These findings contribute to the ongoing discussion of gender roles in relational dynamics and emotional self-determination.

AI.tldr: 基于158名"No Contact Club"在线支持社区成员的调查数据，研究发现女性在单方面结束恋爱关系方面占据主导地位（87.5%），反映了性别在情感能动性、社会支持结构和浪漫选择权方面的差异。
AI.research_question: 恋爱关系解除中是否存在性别不对称？具体而言，男性和女性在单方面结束恋爱关系方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 探讨性别在恋爱关系动态中的角色，特别是女性在关系解除中可能占据主导地位的现象，这反映了性别差异在情感能动性、社会支持结构和浪漫选择权方面的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别角色理论、情感能动性理论、社会支持结构理论、浪漫选择权理论
AI.method: 对158名"No Contact Club"在线支持社区成员进行问卷调查，该社区专注于分手后恢复。数据分析聚焦于单方面结束关系的性别分布。
AI.findings: 30%的受访者报告单方面结束关系，其中87.5%为女性，12.5%为男性。这一结果与长期的社会学研究一致，表明女性在发起分手方面占多数。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性别角色在关系动态中的理论讨论提供实证支持，深化了对情感自我决定中性别差异的理解，验证了女性在关系解除中可能拥有更大情感能动性的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关系咨询和分手恢复支持服务提供性别敏感视角，帮助专业人士更好地理解不同性别在关系结束过程中的不同体验和需求。

title: Africa as a Success Story: Political Organization in Pre-Colonial Africa
affiliations: and University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy

detail.title: Africa as a Success Story: Political Organization in Pre-Colonial Africa

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
We provide an overview of the explanations for the relative lack of state formation historically in Africa. In doing so we systematically document for the first time the extent to which Africa was politically decentralized, calculating that in 1880 there were probably 45,000 independent polities which were rarely organized on ethnic lines. At most 2% of these could be classified as states. We advance a new argument for this extreme political decentralization positing that African societies were deliberately organized to stop centralization emerging. In this they were successful. We point out some key aspects of African societies that helped them to manage this equilibrium. We also emphasize how the organization of the economy was subservient to these political goals.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了非洲历史上国家形成相对缺乏的原因，首次量化记录了1880年非洲存在约45,000个独立政体，其中仅2%可归类为国家。作者提出新论点：非洲社会被刻意组织以阻止中央集权，经济组织也服从于这一政治目标。
AI.research_question: 为什么非洲历史上国家形成相对缺乏？非洲社会如何维持极端政治分权？
AI.motivation: 填补对非洲政治分权程度量化研究的空白，挑战传统解释，提出非洲社会刻意阻止中央集权的新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治分权理论、制度经济学、社会均衡理论、非洲本土政治组织理论
AI.method: 历史数据分析、量化研究（首次系统计算1880年非洲独立政体数量）、比较政治分析
AI.findings: 1. 1880年非洲约有45,000个独立政体，仅2%可归类为国家；2. 这些政体很少按种族线组织；3. 非洲社会被刻意组织以阻止中央集权；4. 经济组织服从于政治分权目标
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统量化非洲政治分权程度；2. 提出非洲社会刻意阻止中央集权的新理论框架；3. 挑战传统国家形成理论在非洲的适用性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解非洲政治发展提供新视角；2. 对非洲治理和发展政策有启示意义；3. 帮助理解非洲当前政治结构的根源

title: The Impacts of Guaranteed Basic Income on Crime Perpetration and Victimization
affiliations: University of Eastern Finland, University of Glasgow and University of Southern California

detail.title: The Impacts of Guaranteed Basic Income on Crime Perpetration and Victimization

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper provides the first experimental evidence on the impact of providing a guaranteed basic income on criminal perpetration and victimization. We analyze a nationwide randomized controlled trial that provided 2,000 unemployed individuals in Finland with an unconditional monthly payment of 560 Euros for two years (2017-2018), while 173,222 comparable individuals remained under the existing social safety net. Using comprehensive administrative data on police reports and district court trials, we estimate precise zero effects on criminal perpetration and victimization. Point estimates are small and statistically insignificant across all crime categories. Our confidence intervals rule out reductions in perpetration of 5 percent or more for crime reports and 10 percent or more for criminal charges.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 芬兰全国性随机对照试验显示，向失业者提供每月560欧元无条件基本收入，对犯罪实施和受害率均无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 提供无条件基本收入对犯罪实施和受害率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 基本收入政策在全球范围内受到关注，但其对犯罪的影响缺乏实证证据，需要了解这种经济保障措施是否会减少犯罪。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于犯罪经济学理论，经济压力可能导致犯罪，基本收入可能通过缓解经济压力而减少犯罪。
AI.method: 全国性随机对照试验，将2,000名失业者随机分配到基本收入组（每月560欧元，持续两年），173,222名类似个体作为对照组，使用警方报告和地方法院审判的行政数据进行评估。
AI.findings: 基本收入对犯罪实施和受害率均无显著影响，所有犯罪类别的点估计值都很小且统计不显著，置信区间排除了犯罪报告减少5%以上或刑事指控减少10%以上的可能性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于基本收入与犯罪关系的首个实验证据，挑战了经济保障会自动减少犯罪的理论假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，表明基本收入政策可能不会显著影响犯罪率，有助于更现实地评估该政策的成本和效益。

title: The Digital Ruble in International Payments. Is it a De-Dollarization Driver or an Instrument of New Sanction Risks?
affiliations: MGIMO and Moscow State University of International Relations

detail.title: The Digital Ruble in International Payments. Is it a De-Dollarization Driver or an Instrument of New Sanction Risks?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Specialists in financial sector, Management, Financial Management, Students.

detail.abstract: This article provides a comprehensive analysis of the prospects for using the digital ruble in international settlements in the context of two key narratives: its potential as a tool for de-dollarization and its role as a factor of sanctions risks. The paper examines the technical and institutional foundations of the digital ruble, its comparative advantages over existing cross-border payment systems, as well as institutional and market constraints for its internationalization. Special attention is paid to the impact of the geopolitical situation and restrictive measures on the process of implementation and possible dissemination of the digital currency. Based on the analysis of statistical data and statements by officials, the real scale of the potential influence of the digital ruble on the architecture of the global financial system is assessed.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了数字卢布在国际结算中的前景，重点关注其作为去美元化工具的潜力和作为制裁风险因素的角色，评估了数字卢布对全球金融体系架构的实际影响。
AI.research_question: 数字卢布在国际结算中的前景如何？它能否成为有效的去美元化工具？在制裁风险背景下，数字卢布对全球金融体系架构会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 随着数字卢布的发展和国际地缘政治变化，需要分析数字卢布在国际结算中的潜力，特别是在去美元化和应对制裁风险方面的作用，为理解新兴数字货币对全球金融体系的影响提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字货币理论、国际结算体系理论、去美元化理论和地缘政治经济学理论，分析数字卢布在国际化过程中的技术、制度和市场约束。
AI.method: 采用综合分析的方法，包括：1）分析数字卢布的技术和制度基础；2）比较数字卢布与现有跨境支付系统的优势；3）分析统计数据和官方声明；4）评估地缘政治和制裁措施的影响。
AI.findings: 数字卢布在国际结算中具有一定潜力，但其国际推广面临技术和制度约束；作为去美元化工具的作用有限，主要受市场接受度和地缘政治因素制约；在制裁风险背景下，数字卢布可能提供替代支付渠道，但对全球金融体系架构的实际影响需要谨慎评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）扩展了数字货币国际化理论框架；2）深化了对数字货币作为地缘政治工具的理解；3）提供了数字主权货币在国际结算中作用的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为政策制定者提供数字卢布国际化的现实评估；2）为金融机构和企业理解数字卢布在国际结算中的风险与机遇提供参考；3）为其他国家发展数字货币的国际应用提供经验借鉴。

title: Redefining Challenges Based on Emergent Gameplay

detail.title: Redefining Challenges Based on Emergent Gameplay
detail.abstract: This article aims to explore the limitations of traditional game challenge models in explaining modern games characterized by emergent gameplay. Using Don't Starve as a case study, this research analyzes its challenge design and finds that traditional models struggle to adequately describe two types of phenomena: first, challenges dynamically triggered by the player's own attributes (such as sanity); second, emergent solutions created by players exploiting the rules of the game's ecosystem (such as directing hostile creatures into combat). Based on these findings, this article proposes extensions to the traditional challenge model: adding an "attribute-influence" property to challenge objects and revising the definition of "helper" property to encompass persistent effects and dynamic changes, with cases demonstrating their practical applications. This research suggests that to adapt to the complexity of open-world games, challenge models must move beyond the traditional "puzzle" framework by incorporating the dynamic relationship between player attributes and challenge objects, while also considering the impact of new challenge types on the overall gaming experience.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了传统游戏挑战模型在解释现代涌现式游戏玩法时的局限性，以《饥荒》为案例研究发现传统模型难以描述两类现象：玩家属性动态触发的挑战，以及玩家利用游戏生态系统规则创造的涌现式解决方案。文章提出了扩展传统挑战模型的方案。
AI.research_question: 传统游戏挑战模型在解释现代涌现式游戏玩法时存在哪些局限性？如何扩展传统挑战模型以适应开放世界游戏的复杂性？
AI.motivation: 传统游戏挑战模型主要基于"谜题"框架，难以充分描述现代游戏中涌现式玩法带来的复杂挑战类型，特别是玩家属性动态触发的挑战和玩家创造性利用游戏规则产生的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统游戏挑战模型、涌现式游戏玩法理论、开放世界游戏设计理论、玩家-环境交互理论。
AI.method: 案例研究法，以《饥荒》为具体案例，分析其挑战设计，识别传统模型无法解释的现象类型。
AI.findings: 发现传统挑战模型难以描述两类现象：1) 由玩家自身属性（如理智值）动态触发的挑战；2) 玩家利用游戏生态系统规则创造的涌现式解决方案（如引导敌对生物互相战斗）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了扩展传统挑战模型的方案：为挑战对象添加"属性影响"属性，修订"辅助"属性的定义以包含持续效果和动态变化，推动挑战模型超越传统"谜题"框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为游戏设计师提供了适应开放世界游戏复杂性的挑战设计框架，帮助设计更动态、更具涌现性的游戏体验，并通过具体案例展示了扩展模型的实际应用。

title: MANIFEST: The System of Belief Built on Conviction, Sustained by Structure
affiliations: MISSION 69B CAPITAL LIMITED

detail.title: MANIFEST: The System of Belief Built on Conviction, Sustained by Structure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no external conflicts of interest. MANIFEST and MISSION 69B CAPITAL LIMITED are author-founded entities, and the purpose of this paper is conceptual and informational only. No part of this manuscript constitutes financial advice, solicitation, or investment promotion.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or personal data; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded through MISSION 69B CAPITAL LIMITED.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the erosion of institutional trust and proposes a belief-based economic framework known as MANIFEST. MANIFEST is a belief-based economic system — a deflationary, treasury-backed architecture built to convert conviction into digital value. It integrates structured participation and transparent treasury governance to establish an alternative foundation for digital coordination. MANIFEST operates as a closed feedback system in which ecosystem yield is directed toward permanent supply reduction, reinforcing scarcity and participant alignment. The framework is anchored by MISSION 69B CAPITAL LIMITED, which provides transparent capital management and converts belief into measurable governance. The result is a structure that treats conviction not as sentiment but as a disciplined, verifiable input to economic coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MANIFEST的信念经济框架，旨在解决制度信任侵蚀问题。该框架通过通缩性、国库支持的架构将信念转化为数字价值，通过结构化参与和透明国库治理建立数字协调的替代基础。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个基于信念的经济框架来解决制度信任侵蚀问题，并将信念转化为可验证的数字价值？
AI.motivation: 制度信任的侵蚀需要新的经济协调机制，将信念从主观情感转化为可验证的经济输入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念经济学、制度信任理论、数字协调机制、通缩经济模型、国库治理框架。
AI.method: 提出MANIFEST框架设计：通缩性、国库支持的架构，包含结构化参与机制、透明国库治理、封闭反馈系统，由MISSION 69B CAPITAL LIMITED提供资本管理支持。
AI.findings: MANIFEST框架能够将信念转化为可衡量的治理输入，通过生态系统收益导向永久供应减少来强化稀缺性和参与者一致性，建立基于信念的数字经济协调基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了信念经济学理论，提出了将信念作为可验证经济输入的概念框架，建立了制度信任与数字价值转换的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可实施的MANIFEST经济系统架构，为数字协调提供了透明治理工具，为机构和个人参与信念经济提供了实践框架。

title: Enhancing Decentralised Renewable Energy Trading through Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology
affiliations: Federal College of Education Iwo, Osun State

detail.title: Enhancing Decentralised Renewable Energy Trading through Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Technology
detail.abstract: Renewable energy system decentralisation requires intelligent, transparent and secure energy generation, transmission, distribution, and trading approaches. This study focuses on the role of artificial intelligence and blockchain technology in enhancing the concept of decentralised renewable energy trading through the reduction of inefficiencies, data ignorance, and trust challenges found in conventional power systems. Artificial intelligence predictive algorithms are used to optimise energy consumption and distribution, and the blockchain immutable registry keeps the integrity, transparency and responsibility of transactions. Collectively, these technologies support the creation of a decent and reliable digital energy market. The study reviewed case studies and related studies from African as well as other global environments to investigate the adoption patterns and infrastructural constraints, and regulatory preparedness in influencing the adoption of these technologies. The findings reveal that artificial intelligence and blockchain technology can significantly enhance the energy efficiency and market transparency but the holistic deployment of the technology remains limited with weak digital infrastructure, limited stakeholder awareness, and regulatory uncertainties. The study recommends a well robust harmonised policy and technical solution, which involves focused investments, regional coordination and institutional capacity building to achieve an equitable decarbonisation. This will offer a practical channel on how to improve the power of the decentralised renewable energy trade in the developing nations and at the same time enhance sustainability, fairness and economic stability.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨人工智能和区块链技术如何通过优化能源消费分配、确保交易透明可信，来提升去中心化可再生能源交易的效率，解决传统电力系统的低效、数据不透明和信任问题。研究发现这些技术能显著提高能效和市场透明度，但在发展中地区面临数字基础设施薄弱、利益相关者认知不足和监管不确定等挑战。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和区块链技术如何通过减少低效率、数据不透明和信任问题，来增强去中心化可再生能源交易？这些技术在非洲及其他全球环境中的采用模式、基础设施约束和监管准备情况如何？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源系统去中心化需要智能、透明和安全的能源生成、传输、分配和交易方法。传统电力系统存在效率低下、数据不透明和信任挑战，需要新技术解决方案来推动公平的脱碳进程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于去中心化能源交易理论、人工智能优化算法理论和区块链分布式账本技术理论，构建了技术赋能的可再生能源市场框架。
AI.method: 通过文献综述和案例研究分析，考察非洲及其他全球环境中的人工智能和区块链技术采用模式、基础设施约束和监管准备情况。
AI.findings: 人工智能和区块链技术能显著提高能源效率和市场透明度，但全面部署受到数字基础设施薄弱、利益相关者认知有限和监管不确定性的限制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了人工智能和区块链技术协同增强去中心化可再生能源交易的理论框架，为技术赋能的能源市场研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议制定协调的政策和技术解决方案，包括针对性投资、区域协调和机构能力建设，为发展中国家改善去中心化可再生能源交易提供实践路径，同时增强可持续性、公平性和经济稳定性。

title: Digital Financial Inclusion as a Catalyst for SME Competitiveness in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences

detail.title: Digital Financial Inclusion as a Catalyst for SME Competitiveness in Sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract: Digital financial inclusion (DFI) has emerged as a critical driver of productivity, competitiveness, and resilience among small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Sub-Saharan Africa. As mobile technology reshapes access to finance, new opportunities are opening for previously excluded entrepreneurs to integrate into regional and global markets. This paper examines how digital financial inclusion strengthens SME competitiveness through access to digital payments, credit, and savings instruments, while also exploring policy and infrastructure challenges that limit its full potential. Drawing on evidence from Nigeria, Kenya, and Ghana, the analysis highlights the importance of digital ecosystems, regulatory frameworks, and gender-responsive innovation. The study concludes that digital financial inclusion, if effectively governed, can serve as a cornerstone for inclusive industrial growth and regional economic integration in Africa.

AI.tldr: 数字金融包容性通过提供数字支付、信贷和储蓄工具，增强了撒哈拉以南非洲中小企业的竞争力，但需要解决政策、基础设施和性别包容性等挑战才能充分发挥其潜力。
AI.research_question: 数字金融包容性如何通过数字支付、信贷和储蓄工具增强撒哈拉以南非洲中小企业的竞争力？
AI.motivation: 移动技术正在重塑金融获取方式，为先前被排除在外的企业家提供了融入区域和全球市场的新机会，数字金融包容性已成为中小企业生产力、竞争力和韧性的关键驱动力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字金融包容性理论、中小企业竞争力理论、数字生态系统理论、包容性增长理论
AI.method: 基于尼日利亚、肯尼亚和加纳的证据进行分析，采用多国案例研究方法
AI.findings: 数字金融包容性通过数字支付、信贷和储蓄工具增强了中小企业竞争力；数字生态系统、监管框架和性别响应型创新对实现其潜力至关重要；政策与基础设施挑战限制了其充分发挥作用
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了数字金融包容性对中小企业竞争力的影响机制理解；深化了数字生态系统在金融包容性中的作用理论；提出了性别响应型创新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了促进数字金融包容性的具体建议；为中小企业利用数字金融工具提升竞争力提供实践指导；为金融机构开发性别响应型产品提供参考；为非洲包容性工业增长和区域经济一体化提供实施路径

title: Delivering Higher Pay? The Impacts of a Task-Level Pay Standard in the Gig Economy
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University, Carnegie Mellon University and Carnegie Mellon University - H. John Heinz III School of Public Policy and Management

detail.title: Delivering Higher Pay? The Impacts of a Task-Level Pay Standard in the Gig Economy

publicationDetails.journalName: NBER Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
How does a task-level minimum pay requirement for gig workers affect their earnings and employment? We study this question in the context of a January 2024 law in Seattle that establishes a per-task minimum pay standard for app-based delivery workers. Drawing on novel cross-platform, trip-level gig activity data, we compare earnings and employment trajectories around the implementation of the law for workers who were doing delivery work in Seattle before the reform against workers who had been active in other regions of Washington State. We find that the minimum pay law raised delivery pay per task, though the increases in base pay per task were partially offset by a substantial reduction in average tips, a major component of delivery pay. At the same time, the policy led to a reduction in the number of tasks completed by highly attached incumbent drivers (but not an increase in exit from delivery work), completely offsetting increased pay per task and leading to zero effect on monthly earnings. We find evidence that drivers experienced more unpaid idle time and longer distances driven between tasks, but find no evidence that drivers reduced their total time working on delivery apps and only limited evidence of switching from delivery to ride-hailing work. Using a simple model of the labor market for platform delivery drivers, we show that our evidence is consistent with free entry of drivers into the delivery market driving down the task-finding rate until expected earnings return to their pre-reform level. These findings highlight the challenges of raising pay in spot markets for tasks where there is free entry of workers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究西雅图2024年实施的零工任务级最低工资政策对配送员收入和就业的影响，发现虽然每单收入增加，但小费减少、任务量下降，最终月收入无变化，原因是自由进入市场导致任务匹配率下降。
AI.research_question: 任务级最低工资要求如何影响零工工人的收入和就业？
AI.motivation: 随着零工经济平台的发展，如何通过政策保障零工工人的收入成为重要议题。西雅图2024年实施的任务级最低工资政策为研究这一政策效果提供了自然实验场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台配送司机劳动力市场的简单模型，强调自由进入市场如何影响任务匹配率和预期收入。
AI.method: 使用跨平台、任务级别的零工活动数据，比较西雅图改革前后配送工人的收入和就业轨迹，以西雅图以外的华盛顿州其他地区工人作为对照组。
AI.findings: 1. 最低工资政策提高了每单配送收入，但基本工资增加被小费大幅减少部分抵消；2. 政策导致高粘性在职司机完成的任务数量减少，完全抵消了每单收入增加，月收入无变化；3. 司机经历更多无薪空闲时间和任务间更长驾驶距离；4. 司机总工作时间未减少，转向网约车工作的证据有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过简单劳动力市场模型证明，自由进入市场导致任务匹配率下降，直到预期收入回到改革前水平，解释了政策效果被抵消的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了在工人自由进入的任务型零工市场中，提高工资政策的挑战性，为政策制定者设计更有效的零工工人保护政策提供了实证依据。

title: Red Line Theory: A Structural Model of Existential Pressure, Psychological Thresholds, and Adaptive Dynamics
affiliations: Baylor University

detail.title: Red Line Theory: A Structural Model of Existential Pressure, Psychological Thresholds, and Adaptive Dynamics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No human participants or ethical approval were required for this theoretical and conceptual study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The interplay between basic survival pressures and higher-order psychological needs remains undertheorized in social science. In this paper, I introduce Red Line Theory, a framework that integrates biological limits, existential thresholds, and adaptive capacity to explain both individual collapse and social upheaval. The theory delineates three central constructs: the Objective Red Line-the non-negotiable material conditions required for survival; the Subjective Red Line-the minimal acceptable conditions for dignity, meaning, and psychological endurance; and Adaptability-the capacity to buffer, shift, or temporarily sustain these thresholds. Situated within holistic and existential thought, the framework extends beyond classical need and deprivation models such as Maslow's hierarchy and relative deprivation theory. When objective conditions fall below biological necessity, physical survival is endangered; when perceived conditions drop beneath the subjective minimum, psychological breakdown or collective revolt becomes likely. Adaptability moderates these dynamics, temporarily averting collapse. The theory explains diverse phenomena-mental disorders, revolutionary movements, and social instability-more comprehensively than one-dimensional models and suggests empirical pathways for operationalization, including survival indices, dignity surveys, and resilience metrics. Red Line Theory thus provides a unified dual-threshold model of human behavior under pressure, bridging physiological necessity and existential purpose. It offers a rigorous yet integrative perspective for understanding stability and crisis across both individual and societal levels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"红线理论"，整合生物极限、存在阈值和适应能力，解释个体崩溃与社会动荡。理论包含客观红线（生存必需物质条件）、主观红线（尊严与心理承受最低条件）和适应能力三个核心概念，超越马斯洛需求层次等传统模型。
AI.research_question: 如何理论化生存压力与高阶心理需求之间的相互作用，以解释个体崩溃和社会动荡？
AI.motivation: 社会科学中生存压力与高阶心理需求的相互作用缺乏充分理论化，现有模型如马斯洛需求层次和相对剥夺理论存在局限性，需要更综合的框架来解释个体和社会层面的崩溃现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 红线理论：整合生物极限、存在阈值和适应能力的双阈值模型。包含三个核心构念：客观红线（生存必需物质条件）、主观红线（尊严、意义和心理承受的最低条件）、适应能力（缓冲、调整或暂时维持这些阈值的能力）。基于整体主义和存在主义思想。
AI.method: 理论构建方法，提出概念框架。建议实证操作化路径：生存指数、尊严调查、韧性指标等测量工具。
AI.findings: 理论预测：客观条件低于生物必需时危及物理生存；感知条件低于主观最低时可能导致心理崩溃或集体反抗；适应能力调节这些动态，暂时避免崩溃。该框架能更全面地解释精神障碍、革命运动和社会不稳定等现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出统一的双阈值模型，连接生理必需与存在目的；2. 超越马斯洛需求层次和相对剥夺理论等经典模型；3. 为理解个体和社会层面的稳定与危机提供严谨而整合的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供解释精神障碍、革命运动和社会不稳定等现象的理论工具；2. 建议实证操作化方法（生存指数、尊严调查、韧性指标）；3. 为政策制定者提供理解社会危机和干预的理论基础。

reference: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
title: Data-Driven Innovation And Privacy Concerns In A Schumpeterian Growth Model
affiliations: University of Auckland Business School, University of Auckland Business School and University of Auckland

detail.title: Data-Driven Innovation And Privacy Concerns In A Schumpeterian Growth Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper (forthcoming)
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a Schumpeterian growth model in which consumer data are used as the R&D input for quality improvements, and consumers balance the economic benefits of selling their consumption data against privacy concerns. In the market equilibrium, a higher degree of privacy concerns reduces the supply of consumer data, hindering innovation and thereby slowing down growth. This finding is consistent with our crosscountry empirical evidence that privacy concerns are negatively correlated with regional digital development. Furthermore, our model shows that if the degree of privacy concerns exceeds a certain threshold, the decentralized equilibrium features socially excessive innovation, suggesting that data use should be more strictly regulated or taxed. In contrast, if the degree of privacy concerns is lower than this threshold value, innovation in the decentralized equilibrium is below the socially efficient level, and policies that promote or subsidize data use become socially desirable. These findings help us understand crosscountry differences in data regulation policies.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，将消费者数据作为质量改进的研发投入，消费者在出售消费数据的经济收益与隐私担忧之间权衡。研究发现隐私担忧会减少数据供给，阻碍创新和增长。当隐私担忧超过阈值时，市场均衡会出现过度创新，需要更严格的数据监管；低于阈值时则创新不足，需要促进数据使用的政策。
AI.research_question: 消费者隐私担忧如何影响基于数据驱动的创新和经济增长？在什么条件下市场均衡的创新水平会偏离社会最优水平？
AI.motivation: 随着数字经济兴起，消费者数据成为重要生产要素，但隐私担忧可能限制数据供给。理解隐私担忧对创新和增长的影响，以及如何制定适当的数据监管政策，具有重要理论和现实意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 熊彼特增长理论（Schumpeterian growth model），将消费者数据作为研发投入，消费者在数据出售的经济收益与隐私成本之间进行权衡。
AI.method: 理论模型构建与均衡分析，结合跨国实证证据验证理论预测。
AI.findings: 1. 隐私担忧程度越高，消费者数据供给越少，创新和增长越慢（与跨国数字发展数据一致）。2. 存在一个隐私担忧阈值：超过阈值时市场均衡创新过度，需要更严格监管或征税；低于阈值时创新不足，需要促进或补贴数据使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将隐私担忧纳入熊彼特增长框架，分析数据作为生产要素的经济影响。2. 识别市场均衡偏离社会最优的条件，为数据监管政策提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释了各国数据监管政策差异的原因。2. 为政策制定者提供了判断何时需要加强监管或促进数据使用的决策框架。

title: The Economics of Socio-Ecological Transformations. A conceptual framework
affiliations: Johannes Kepler University of Linz - Institute for Comprehensive Analysis of the Economy (ICAE) and Johannes Kepler University Linz

detail.title: The Economics of Socio-Ecological Transformations. A conceptual framework
detail.abstract: The paper introduces the SETER framework, a conceptual tool for analyzing the interplay between Socio-Ecological Transformation (SET) and Economic Reasoning (ER). In the context of global crises and the contested nature of sustainability discourses, the framework identifies nine key categories – ranging from economic goals and the role of the state to transformative dynamics and agency – to systematically compare diverse SET narratives and their basic underlying economic assumptions. Drawing on insights from Social Studies of Economics (SSE) and Sustainability Transitions Research (STR), the framework highlights how ER shapes SET discourses and potential pathways, influencing both the diagnosis of socio-ecological crises and its proposed solutions. The paper applies the framework for two contrasting cases: the EU Green Deal, which exemplifies a market-driven “green growth” narrative, and Kōhei Saitō’s Degrowth Manifesto, which advocates for commons-based, sufficiency-orientated transformation. These cases illustrate the framework’s ability to map competing visions of SET, revealing the systemic dependencies between ER categories and their manifestations. The SETER framework also enables a typification of antagonistic narratives opposing SET, such as techno-libertarian or fossil-modernization discourses. While the framework provides a useful tool for categorising and comparing SET narratives, its integration with power-focused analytical tools is necessary to assess the performative influence of these narratives. By offering a flexible, cross-sectoral, and longitudinal approach, the SETER framework provides a robust methodology for navigating the complexities of SET-related discourses, current counter-developments, and the critical role of economic imaginaries.

AI.tldr: SETER框架是一个概念工具，用于分析社会生态转型与经济推理之间的相互作用，通过九个关键类别系统比较不同的转型叙事及其经济假设，并应用于欧盟绿色协议和斋藤幸平的《去增长宣言》两个案例。
AI.research_question: 如何系统分析和比较不同社会生态转型叙事及其基本经济假设之间的相互关系？
AI.motivation: 在全球危机和可持续发展话语争议的背景下，需要理解经济推理如何塑造社会生态转型话语和潜在路径，影响对危机的诊断和解决方案的提出。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合经济学社会研究（SSE）和可持续转型研究（STR）的见解，构建SETER框架，包含经济目标、国家角色、转型动态、能动性等九个关键类别。
AI.method: 概念框架开发与案例比较分析：将SETER框架应用于欧盟绿色协议（市场驱动的"绿色增长"叙事）和斋藤幸平的《去增长宣言》（基于公地、充足导向的转型）两个对比案例。
AI.findings: SETER框架能够有效映射竞争性的社会生态转型愿景，揭示经济推理类别之间的系统性依赖关系及其表现形式；框架还能对反对社会生态转型的对抗性叙事进行类型化分析。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了SETER概念框架，为社会生态转型与经济推理的交叉研究提供了系统分析工具；整合了SSE和STR的理论见解；提供了灵活、跨部门、纵向的分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、研究人员和社会行动者提供了导航社会生态转型相关话语复杂性的实用工具；能够识别和比较不同的转型路径；有助于理解经济想象的关键作用。

title: Environmental and economic effects of pay-as-you-throw waste taxation: an assessment based on difference-in-differences models
affiliations: University of Milano Bicocca and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Environmental and economic effects of pay-as-you-throw waste taxation: an assessment based on difference-in-differences models
detail.abstract: Excessive municipal waste generation remains a pressing environmental challenge in the European Union, motivating the adoption of policies such as Pay-As-You-Throw (PAYT) schemes that link household waste management fees to unsorted waste production. Rigorous evaluation of PAYT’s effects is complicated by staggered policy adoption and non-reliable parallel trends across municipalities, which can bias standard Difference-in-Differences (DiD) estimates. We address this challenge by comparing two-way fixed effects DiD, staggered DiD, and Synthetic DiD (SDID) approaches. Applying this framework to the staggered PAYT rollout in the Italian region of Emilia-Romagna, we find a robust 10% increase in sorted waste collection rates on average. This shift is almost entirely due to a reduction of unsorted waste per capita, without a significant growth of sorted waste generated, aligning to the top priority of the EU Waste Hierarchy, i.e. waste prevention. Importantly, PAYT does not significantly raise the total cost of the waste management service on average, although it does involve a shift in the composition of cost components. Thus, the study underscores the potential of PAYT as an economically viable policy instrument for municipalities and regions to advance urban waste management in line with circular economy objectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区"按量收费"(PAYT)政策对垃圾分类的影响，使用多种DID方法发现PAYT使分类垃圾收集率平均提高10%，主要通过减少未分类垃圾而非增加分类垃圾产生量，且不显著增加总成本，支持PAYT作为经济可行的循环经济政策工具。
AI.research_question: PAYT政策对垃圾分类收集率有何影响？这种影响是通过减少未分类垃圾还是增加分类垃圾产生量实现的？PAYT政策是否会显著增加垃圾管理总成本？
AI.motivation: 欧盟面临过度城市垃圾产生的环境挑战，PAYT政策将家庭垃圾管理费与未分类垃圾产生量挂钩，但政策效果评估因交错实施和非可靠平行趋势而复杂化，需要更严谨的方法评估PAYT的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学中的激励理论，PAYT通过价格信号激励家庭减少未分类垃圾产生；采用欧盟废物等级制度框架，强调废物预防优先于回收利用；应用政策评估中的因果推断方法。
AI.method: 比较三种DID方法：双向固定效应DID、交错DID和合成DID(SDID)，应用于意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区PAYT政策的交错实施数据，解决政策评估中的偏差问题。
AI.findings: PAYT政策使分类垃圾收集率平均提高10%；这种变化几乎完全源于人均未分类垃圾的减少，而非分类垃圾产生量的显著增长；PAYT不显著增加垃圾管理服务总成本，但改变了成本构成。
AI.theory_contributions: 为PAYT政策评估提供了更严谨的方法论框架，比较了不同DID方法在处理交错政策实施中的适用性；验证了价格激励在废物管理中的有效性；支持欧盟废物等级制度中废物预防优先的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市政当局和地区提供了PAYT政策有效性的实证证据；表明PAYT是经济可行的政策工具，可在不显著增加总成本的情况下促进循环经济目标；为政策制定者提供了实施PAYT的决策依据。

title: Strategic Asset Allocation with Generalized Homothetic Robust Epstein-Zin Utility under a Quadratic Model
affiliations: Shiga University and Shiga University

detail.title: Strategic Asset Allocation with Generalized Homothetic Robust Epstein-Zin Utility under a Quadratic Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.funderStatement: A part of this study was supported by Japan Society for the Promotion of Science Grant-in-Aid for Scientific Research(C) Grant Number JP20K01768 and by Ishii Memorial Securities Research Promotion Foundation.

detail.abstract: This study proposes "generalized homothetic robust Epstein-Zin (GHREZ) utility," in which the coefficient of relative ambiguity aversion in homothetic robust Epstein-Zin (HREZ) utility is generalized to a positive-definite matrix of relative ambiguity aversions. We analyze a robust consumptioninvestment problem with GHREZ utility under a quadratic security market model. We demonstrate that the volatility of the optimal robust portfolio can be expressed as a weighted average of the market price of risk and the "investor hedging value of intertemporal uncertainty." We derive an approximate optimal robust portfolio and quantitatively analyze the relationship between the approximate optimal robust portfolios and relative ambiguity aversion matrices. Numerical analysis reveals that as deviations from the relative ambiguity aversion matrix under HREZ utility increase, deviations from the approximate optimal asset allocation under HREZ utility also increase, and the sensitivity is significant. This finding suggests that GHREZ utility is promising for solving the equity home bias puzzle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出广义齐次稳健Epstein-Zin效用函数，将相对模糊厌恶系数推广为正定矩阵，分析二次证券市场模型下的稳健消费投资问题，发现最优稳健投资组合波动率可表示为市场风险价格和"投资者跨期不确定性对冲价值"的加权平均，并通过数值分析表明该模型有望解决股权本土偏好之谜。
AI.research_question: 在广义齐次稳健Epstein-Zin效用函数框架下，如何分析二次证券市场模型中的稳健消费投资问题，以及相对模糊厌恶矩阵如何影响最优投资组合？
AI.motivation: 将传统的齐次稳健Epstein-Zin效用函数中的标量相对模糊厌恶系数推广为矩阵形式，以更好地捕捉投资者对不同风险源的模糊厌恶程度差异，为解决股权本土偏好等资产配置难题提供更精细的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义齐次稳健Epstein-Zin效用函数理论，将相对模糊厌恶系数从标量推广为正定矩阵；稳健控制理论；二次证券市场模型；跨期资产定价理论。
AI.method: 理论建模与推导：构建GHREZ效用函数框架下的稳健消费投资优化问题；解析推导最优稳健投资组合的波动率表达式；推导近似最优稳健投资组合；数值模拟分析相对模糊厌恶矩阵变化对资产配置的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 最优稳健投资组合波动率可表示为市场风险价格和"投资者跨期不确定性对冲价值"的加权平均；2. 相对模糊厌恶矩阵偏离HREZ效用下的设定越大，资产配置偏离HREZ下的近似最优配置也越大，且敏感性显著；3. GHREZ效用函数有望解决股权本土偏好之谜。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出广义齐次稳健Epstein-Zin效用函数，将相对模糊厌恶系数推广为矩阵形式；2. 在二次证券市场模型下建立了完整的稳健消费投资理论框架；3. 揭示了最优稳健投资组合波动率的结构特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为资产配置决策提供了考虑多维模糊厌恶的理论工具；2. 为解释股权本土偏好等实证现象提供了新的理论视角；3. 为投资者处理跨期不确定性提供了实用的对冲策略框架。

title: Quasi-Judicial: A History and Tradition
affiliations: Yale Law School and Boston University - School of Law

detail.title: Quasi-Judicial: A History and Tradition
detail.abstract:
In challenging the historical assumptions underlying the unitary executive theory, scholars have made several seemingly unrelated discoveries. First, "judicial" power was conceived in English law as a subset of "executive" authority. Second, Congress at or near the Founding insulated certain court-like comissions from presidential control. Finally, the "quasi-judicial" and "quasi-legislative" powers that were central to the holding of Humphrey's Executor flowed from a forgotten nineteenth-century legal tradition was guiding Congress's construction of the modern state. This Essay connects these findings into a single claim: generations of American stretching back past the Founding have instinctively insulated administrators granted quasi-judicial functions from hierarchical control and presidential removal. Americans expect judge-like independence when politicians grant administrators judge-like powers and functions.

The quasi-judicial category deployed in Humphrey's was the logical extension of English legal customs, Founding Era administration, and the evolution of the ninteenth-century law of officeholding. It reflected an Anglo-American instinct to insulate judge-like offices from direct hierarchical control. Whether you are an originalist or a believer in the history-and-tradition approach, these findings show that Congress may insulate quasi-judicial officials from presidential removal and direction. Beyond original public meaning, the quasi-judicial function from Humphrey's is bound up with the Anglo-American constitutional project stretching back beyond the Founding. If the Roberts Court overrules Humphrey's, it will imperil a primordial instinct that is part of our rule-of-law tradition.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了单一行政理论的历史假设，揭示了美国行政法中"准司法"职能的历史根源，论证了国会可以隔离具有准司法职能的行政官员免受总统控制和免职，这一传统可追溯至建国时期甚至更早的英国法律传统。
AI.research_question: 国会是否有权隔离具有准司法职能的行政官员免受总统控制和免职？这一权力在历史和宪法传统中是否有依据？
AI.motivation: 挑战单一行政理论的历史假设，揭示美国行政法中"准司法"概念的历史根源和宪法传统，为国会隔离行政官员的权力提供历史和法律依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 单一行政理论挑战；2. 英国法律传统中司法权作为行政权子集的概念；3. 建国时期国会隔离法院式委员会免受总统控制的实践；4. 19世纪"准司法"和"准立法"权力的法律传统；5. 英美宪法传统中的规则意识。
AI.method: 历史法律分析方法，通过考察英国法律传统、建国时期立法实践、19世纪法律发展以及Humphrey's Executor案的历史背景，构建连贯的历史论证。
AI.findings: 1. 司法权在英国法律中被视为行政权的子集；2. 建国时期国会确实隔离了某些法院式委员会免受总统控制；3. "准司法"和"准立法"权力源于19世纪被遗忘的法律传统；4. 美国历史上存在隔离具有准司法职能行政官员的传统；5. 这一传统反映了英美法律中隔离法官式职位免受直接层级控制的直觉。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了单一行政理论的历史假设；2. 建立了"准司法"职能的历史谱系；3. 为国会隔离行政官员的权力提供了历史依据；4. 连接了英国法律传统、建国实践和现代行政法；5. 为原始主义和历史传统方法提供了新的解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为国会隔离具有准司法职能的行政官员提供了法律依据；2. 支持Humphrey's Executor案的宪法基础；3. 警告Roberts法院推翻Humphrey's案可能危及法治传统；4. 为行政法实践提供了历史视角；5. 强化了行政官员独立性的宪法传统。

title: Willingness to pay for birdsong
affiliations: University of Glasgow, Brandenburg University of Technology Cottbus-Senftenberg, University of East Anglia, University of East Anglia, University of East Anglia, University of Surrey, University of Surrey, University of Surrey and University of Glasgow - Boyd Orr Centre for Population and Ecosystem Health

detail.title: Willingness to pay for birdsong
detail.abstract: We present the first estimate of the causal effect of auditory sensation on willingness to pay and the first estimate of the marginal value of bird song, using constructed soundscapes. We compare willingness to pay values for increases in bird wildlife habitat quality and quantity between samples where respondents are played recordings of soundscapes compared to respondents who do not get to listen to these simulated soundscapes. Preferences for the costs of habitat restoration and willingness to pay for habitat quality enhancements were found to be significantly larger in the “with soundscapes” sample. Methodologically, this paper reports on the use of simulated soundscapes in choice experiments as a means of increasing the information respondents have before making their choices.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次评估了听觉感知对支付意愿的因果效应，以及鸟鸣的边际价值。通过构建声音景观实验，发现听到鸟鸣声的受访者对栖息地恢复和质量的支付意愿显著更高。
AI.research_question: 听觉感知（特别是鸟鸣声）如何影响人们对野生动物栖息地保护和恢复的支付意愿？鸟鸣声的边际价值是多少？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对听觉体验在环境价值评估中因果效应的量化分析，特别是鸟鸣声作为生态系统服务组成部分的经济价值尚未得到准确测量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境经济学中的条件价值评估法（CVM）和选择实验法，结合感官体验对决策影响的行为经济学理论。
AI.method: 采用随机对照实验设计，将受访者分为"有声景观"组（播放模拟鸟鸣声）和"无声景观"组，通过选择实验测量对栖息地质量提升和数量增加的支付意愿差异。
AI.findings: 听到鸟鸣声的受访者对栖息地恢复成本和质量提升的支付意愿显著高于对照组，证实了听觉感知对环境保护偏好的因果影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次量化了听觉感知对环境偏好的因果效应，提出了声音景观作为生态系统服务价值评估的新维度，拓展了感官体验在环境决策中的作用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估鸟类保护项目经济价值的新方法，展示了声音景观模拟在提高环境决策信息质量方面的应用潜力。

title: Generative AI as a Statistical Tool: Applications, Limitations, and Cross-Validation Methods
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business

detail.title: Generative AI as a Statistical Tool: Applications, Limitations, and Cross-Validation Methods
detail.abstract: This paper examines the application of generative AI tools in solving statistical problems and teaching statistical concepts. The study demonstrates how AI platforms like ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and others can perform various statistical analyses, including hypothesis testing (one-sample, two-sample, and proportion tests), confidence interval estimation, contingency table analysis, and regression modeling (linear and logistic). Through practical examples involving real-world scenarios, from testing die fairness to predicting employee retention, the paper illustrates AI's capability to handle complex statistical computations without requiring users to understand underlying distributions or technical procedures. However, the analysis reveals significant reliability concerns, as some AI tools produce incorrect results for specific problems. The paper emphasizes the critical importance of cross-validation across multiple platforms and highlights AI's dual role as both a powerful computational tool and a potential teaching aid, provided proper verification protocols are followed.

AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了基础设施互联互通作为外交工具的理论框架；2. 提出了经济项目驱动政治正常化的新模式；3. 丰富了区域一体化理论在跨区域连接中的应用；4. 发展了多边经济走廊建设的地缘政治理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为美沙关系修复提供具体实施路径；2. 为沙以关系正常化创造经济基础；3. 为区域国家提供基础设施建设合作模式；4. 为印度与中东经济连接开辟新通道；5. 为I2U2合作框架提供实质性项目支撑。

title: Office Leasing Resilience in the Remote and Hybrid Era: The Role of Sustainability and Urbanity
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Graduate School of Design and Florida State University - Department of Risk Management/Insurance, Real Estate and Business Law

detail.title: Office Leasing Resilience in the Remote and Hybrid Era: The Role of Sustainability and Urbanity
detail.abstract: The shift toward remote and hybrid work (RHW) has reduced overall office leasing activity and sparked new questions about the future of urban office space. This study exploits the natural office leasing experiment that arose from the post-pandemic, RHW era of office leasing market to investigate if sustainable and urban characteristics of office spaces moderate office leasing activity during the market's "flight to quality" period. Using a proprietary dataset covering the Canadian office market after 2020-one of the world's most stabilized RHW environments-we combine leasing, sustainability, and urbanity data to explore how organizational and employee preferences shape space utilization. Findings show that sustainability certifications-both at the asset and landlord level-have cemented their role in the modern definition of high-quality office buildings, and that the strongest demand for office space is situated in vibrant urban areas. Investment in creating sustainable and urban office environments is associated with strong leasing activity. Specifically, such buildings are associated with a more resilient and diverse tenancy, especially from critical industries and those industries embracing physical office space despite being well-fit for RHW.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用后疫情时代远程/混合工作模式下的自然实验，探讨可持续性和城市特征如何调节写字楼租赁活动。研究发现，可持续性认证已成为高质量写字楼的核心要素，而最具活力的城市区域对办公空间需求最强。投资创建可持续和城市化的办公环境与强劲的租赁活动相关，特别是能吸引关键行业和适合远程工作但仍重视实体办公空间的行业。
AI.research_question: 在"向质量转移"的市场时期，办公空间的可持续性和城市特征是否调节写字楼租赁活动？
AI.motivation: 远程和混合工作模式的转变减少了整体办公室租赁活动，引发了关于城市办公空间未来的新问题。后疫情时代为研究组织如何在"向质量转移"时期选择办公空间提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 办公空间质量理论（包括可持续性作为质量维度）
2. 城市活力与办公需求关系理论
3. 组织偏好与空间利用理论
4. "向质量转移"市场行为理论
AI.method: 使用2020年后加拿大写字楼市场的专有数据集（全球最稳定的远程/混合工作环境之一），结合租赁数据、可持续性数据和城市性数据，采用实证分析方法探索组织和员工偏好如何塑造空间利用。
AI.findings:
1. 可持续性认证（资产层面和业主层面）已成为现代高质量写字楼定义的核心要素
2. 对办公空间的最强需求位于充满活力的城市区域
3. 投资创建可持续和城市化的办公环境与强劲的租赁活动相关
4. 这类建筑与更具韧性和多样化的租户组合相关，特别是来自关键行业和那些尽管适合远程工作但仍拥抱实体办公空间的行业
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了办公空间质量的理论框架，将可持续性和城市特征作为重要维度
2. 深化了对"向质量转移"现象的理解，特别是可持续性和城市活力的作用
3. 为后疫情时代办公空间需求理论提供了实证支持
4. 丰富了组织空间选择偏好的理论解释
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为写字楼开发商和业主提供投资决策指导：应优先投资可持续性和城市活力
2. 为城市规划者提供政策启示：支持可持续和城市化的办公环境发展
3. 为企业选址决策提供参考：高质量可持续办公空间能吸引关键行业租户
4. 为房地产投资者识别具有韧性的办公资产提供标准

title: Applications of Distributed Ledger Technology in Capital Companies

detail.title: Applications of Distributed Ledger Technology in Capital Companies

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.

detail.abstract: Technology based on distributed ledger systems (DLT), one of the best-known examples of which is blockchain, has clear applications in the functioning of capital companies, not only internally in the organisation and operation of the company itself (ad intra), but also ad extra, as soon as potential investors can use the technology to finance the company’s activity in the market.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨分布式账本技术（DLT，如区块链）在资本公司内外部运作中的应用，包括公司内部组织运营和外部投资者融资支持。
AI.research_question: 分布式账本技术如何应用于资本公司的内部运作和外部融资活动？
AI.motivation: 分布式账本技术（如区块链）在金融和公司治理领域具有变革潜力，但对其在资本公司具体应用场景的系统性研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、分布式账本技术理论、金融科技理论、公司融资理论
AI.method: 理论分析、案例研究、文献综述
AI.findings: DLT技术可在资本公司内部（组织运营）和外部（投资者融资）两个维度应用，提升透明度、效率和可信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了DLT技术在资本公司应用的理论框架，区分了ad intra和ad extra两个应用维度，丰富了金融科技与公司治理交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资本公司应用DLT技术提供实践指导，帮助投资者理解技术支持的融资模式，促进区块链技术在传统公司治理中的落地。

title: Payment Choice and the Pain of Paying: Evidence on Tipping Behavior from Payment Diary Data
affiliations: and University of St.Gallen - Swiss Payment Behaviour Lab

detail.title: Payment Choice and the Pain of Paying: Evidence on Tipping Behavior from Payment Diary Data
detail.abstract: We examine how payment methods and the perceived pain of paying shape tipping behavior. Using unique transaction-level payment diary data from Switzerland for 2024-2025, we estimate the effects of the most common payment instruments—cash, debit and credit cards, and mobile payments—on both the likelihood and amount of tipping. We also analyze how subjective pain of paying interacts with these tipping choices. Our results show that both payment method and the pain of paying exert statistically and economically significant influences on tipping behavior. Relative to cash, electronic payment methods are associated with a lower probability of tipping. However, this difference in tipping probability between the payment methods disappears when the bill totals a round amount, i.e. a multiple of CHF 5 or CHF 10. Conditional on tipping, electronic payment methods result in smaller tip amounts for an average bill amount of CHF 32.45. However, this effect reverts for bill amounts larger than CHF 90. We find no meaningful difference in tipping behavior between contactless and chip-and-PIN card transactions.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用瑞士2024-2025年的交易数据，分析支付方式和支付痛苦感如何影响小费行为。研究发现电子支付（借记卡、信用卡、移动支付）相比现金会降低给小费的概率和金额，但账单为整数金额时这种差异消失。支付痛苦感对小费行为有显著影响。
AI.research_question: 支付方式和支付痛苦感如何影响小费行为（包括给小费的概率和金额）？
AI.motivation: 随着电子支付方式的普及，理解不同支付方式如何影响消费者的小费行为具有重要现实意义。支付方式可能通过改变支付痛苦感（pain of paying）来影响消费决策，包括小费行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于支付痛苦感理论（pain of paying），该理论认为不同支付方式会引发不同程度的心理痛苦，从而影响消费决策。现金支付通常被认为比电子支付更具"痛苦感"，因为现金的物理交换更直接可见。
AI.method: 使用瑞士2024-2025年的交易级支付日记数据，采用计量经济学方法估计不同支付工具（现金、借记卡、信用卡、移动支付）对小费概率和金额的影响，并分析支付痛苦感的中介作用。
AI.findings: 1. 相比现金，电子支付方式与小费概率较低相关；2. 当账单金额为整数（5或10瑞士法郎的倍数）时，支付方式对小费概率的影响消失；3. 在给小费的情况下，电子支付导致较小的小费金额（平均账单32.45瑞士法郎时）；4. 当账单金额超过90瑞士法郎时，这种效应反转；5. 非接触式与芯片密码卡交易在小费行为上无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了支付痛苦感理论在小费行为中的应用，实证验证了支付方式通过改变支付痛苦感影响小费决策的机制，揭示了账单金额特征（是否为整数）对支付方式效应的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务行业提供支付策略建议：在低金额交易中，鼓励现金支付可能增加小费收入；在高金额交易中，电子支付可能更有利。同时，设计账单金额为整数可能减少支付方式对小费的影响差异。

title: Pillar Two Side-by-Side Challenges of EU Law, Global Tax Governance, Sovereignty. Comments for a Rational Win-Win Path Forward
affiliations: Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law and Texas A&M University (TAMU), School of Law

detail.title: Pillar Two Side-by-Side Challenges of EU Law, Global Tax Governance, Sovereignty. Comments for a Rational Win-Win Path Forward
detail.abstract: The European Union has transposed Pillar Two into EU law, requiring Member States to implement a top-up tax system, including an income-inclusion rule (IIR) and an undertaxed profits rule (UTPR), to ensure that every in-scope MNE pays an effective rate of at least 15 percent in each jurisdiction starting 2026.[1] Republicans of the Ways and Means Committee, from whence tax legislation originates, have this week (the first week of December 2025) stated that if a Pillar Two Side-by-Side agreement (the “Agreement”)[2] with the U.S. Treasury is not in place by year’s end, then Congress will re-propose the retaliatory I.R.C. Section 899.[3] Meanwhile, I.R.C. Section 891, enacted in 1934, remains as an active retaliation standby, albeit nearly all EU countries have a tax treaty with the U.S. that is “last in time.” The U.S. minimum tax regime and the Pillar 2 regime are certainly not identical; otherwise, there would not be a need to hammer out a comparability agreement. But neither does the U.S. minimum corporate tax regime establish a more tax-competitive environment for U.S. headquartered multinationals. The U.S. minimum corporate tax regime is comprised of four core elements: (1) controlled foreign corporation deemed income inclusion pursuant to Subpart F, (2) controlled foreign corporation deemed income inclusion pursuant to Net CFC Tested Income (NCTI) (formerly GILTI before 2026), (3) the Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax (CAMT), and (4) the Base Erosion and Anti-Abuse Tax (BEAT). The NCTI aspect of the U.S. minimum corporate tax regime does not allow either of the significant Pillar 2 exclusions: the substance-based income exclusion or the qualified refundable tax credit exception.[4] When the four aspects are examined in totality, we find a robust tax web with significantly higher compliance costs than any EU regime under Pillar 2; indeed, not a lenient leaky bucket.

AI.tldr: 欧盟已实施支柱二规则，要求成员国从2026年起对跨国企业实施至少15%的有效税率。美国共和党威胁若年底前未与财政部达成支柱二并行协议，将重新提出报复性税法条款。美国最低企业税制包含四大要素，比欧盟支柱二制度更复杂且合规成本更高。
AI.research_question: 欧盟支柱二规则与美国最低企业税制之间的差异如何影响跨国企业的税务合规和全球税收协调？
AI.motivation: 欧盟已通过支柱二立法，而美国共和党威胁采取报复性措施，两国税制存在显著差异，可能引发税务冲突并增加跨国企业合规负担。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际税收协调理论、税收竞争理论、跨国企业税务合规理论、全球最低税制比较分析框架
AI.method: 比较制度分析法、法律文本分析、政策对比研究、合规成本评估
AI.findings: 1. 欧盟支柱二与美国最低税制存在实质性差异，特别是NCTI部分不允许支柱二的两个重要排除项；2. 美国税制包含四大要素，形成复杂的税收网络；3. 美国制度的合规成本显著高于欧盟支柱二制度；4. 两国税制差异可能引发税务冲突和报复性措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了跨国税收制度差异对全球税收协调的影响框架；2. 分析了不同最低税制设计对合规成本的理论影响；3. 探讨了税收报复机制在国际税收协调中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为跨国企业提供两国税制差异的实用分析；2. 识别美国税制的高合规成本风险；3. 为企业应对可能的税收冲突提供策略建议；4. 为政策制定者提供协调两国税制的参考依据。

title: Will AI Improve Undergraduate Economics Education?
affiliations: University of Southern California

detail.title: Will AI Improve Undergraduate Economics Education?
detail.abstract: For decades, undergraduate economics educators have followed a well-worn playbook featuring textbooks, lectures and problem sets. Students have passively listened, taken notes and studied for exams. AI disrupts this educational process. Some students are using this tool as a substitute for their own precious time. What is our best response? This paper provides a prospective analysis of how to restructure every phase of the undergraduate economics experience to improve the major and better prepare students for their uncertain future. Departments face a principal/agent issue in implementing major curricular reforms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人工智能如何颠覆传统经济学本科教育模式，提出重构经济学专业课程体系以应对AI挑战，并分析院系在实施重大课程改革时面临的主体/代理问题。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能颠覆传统经济学教育的背景下，如何重构本科经济学专业的所有阶段以改善专业质量并更好地为学生的不确定未来做准备？
AI.motivation: 数十年来，本科经济学教育一直遵循着教科书、讲座和习题集的传统模式，学生被动听讲、记笔记和备考。AI正在颠覆这一教育过程，一些学生将其作为替代自己宝贵学习时间的工具。教育者需要找到最佳应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主体/代理理论（用于分析院系实施课程改革时面临的问题），教育技术变革理论，课程重构理论。
AI.method: 前瞻性分析（prospective analysis），基于现有教育实践和AI技术发展趋势的理论分析。
AI.findings: AI正在颠覆传统经济学教育模式，需要全面重构本科经济学专业的各个阶段。院系在实施重大课程改革时面临主体/代理问题，需要有效的改革策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 将主体/代理理论应用于高等教育课程改革分析，提出AI时代经济学教育重构的理论框架，为教育技术变革理论提供经济学教育领域的应用案例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学教育者提供应对AI挑战的具体策略，为院系实施课程改革提供实践指导，帮助学生更好地为不确定的未来做准备，改善经济学专业的教育质量。

title: The Immediate Global Impact of US Monetary Policy
affiliations: University of Oxford - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Immediate Global Impact of US Monetary Policy
detail.abstract: We measure international monetary policy spillovers using US-traded country ETFs, which provide real-time price discovery for foreign equity markets during Federal Reserve announcements. A geographic discontinuity validates our approach: ETF returns predict overnight index gaps only for markets closed during the announcement. A typical contractionary surprise generates immediate, universally negative spillovers, destroying approximately $280 billion in foreign equity value within thirty minutes. This transmission appears in every country examined, regardless of exchange rate regime, development level, or capital account openness. The unanimity and speed of these effects provide high-frequency evidence consistent with a global financial cycle Rey (2015) driven by US monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用美国交易的国家ETF测量美联储政策公告对全球股市的实时溢出效应，发现典型的紧缩性意外在30分钟内导致约2800亿美元的外国股票价值损失，且影响遍及所有国家，支持由美国货币政策驱动的全球金融周期理论。
AI.research_question: 美联储货币政策公告如何实时影响全球股票市场？这种溢出效应是否普遍存在于不同国家，无论其汇率制度、发展水平或资本账户开放程度如何？
AI.motivation: 理解美国货币政策对全球金融市场的实时影响机制，验证全球金融周期理论在高频数据中的表现，为国际资本流动和金融稳定提供实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球金融周期理论（Rey, 2015），强调美国货币政策作为全球金融周期的主要驱动力，通过风险承担渠道和资本流动影响全球资产价格。
AI.method: 利用美国交易的国家ETF作为实时价格发现工具，采用地理断点设计验证方法：比较在美联储公告期间开放和关闭的市场，分析ETF回报对隔夜指数缺口的预测能力。
AI.findings: 1. 典型的紧缩性意外在30分钟内导致约2800亿美元的外国股票价值损失；2. 溢出效应在所有被研究国家中普遍存在，不受汇率制度、发展水平或资本账户开放程度影响；3. ETF回报仅能预测在公告期间关闭的市场的隔夜指数缺口；4. 影响具有一致性和即时性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为全球金融周期理论提供了高频实证证据，证实美国货币政策是全球金融周期的主要驱动力，支持风险承担渠道在国际资本流动中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实时监测国际金融溢出效应的工具，帮助投资者理解全球市场联动机制，为风险管理提供实证依据，对国际金融稳定政策有重要启示。

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available economic data and does not involve human participants. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract: This paper provides a decadal review of India–U.S. trade relations from 2012 to 2022, focusing on trends in exports, imports, and trade balance. Using official government data and a quantitative framework, the analysis divides the period into pre-COVID (2012–2019) and post-COVID (2019–2022) phases to capture both long-term structural dynamics and the impact of global disruption. Results show that India consistently maintained a trade surplus, driven by labor-intensive and resourcebased exports such as textiles and pharmaceuticals, while the U.S. dominated in capital- and technology-intensive goods. The COVID-19 shock temporarily reduced trade volumes in 2020, but recovery was rapid, with 2021–2022 reflecting renewed momentum and diversification. The study concludes that bilateral trade is structurally resilient and strategically significant, supported by complementary advantages and reinforced by global supply-chain shifts. These findings underline the importance of the India–U.S. partnership as a stabilizing force in global economic relations.

AI.tldr: 本文对2012-2022年印美贸易关系进行十年回顾，分析进出口和贸易平衡趋势，发现印度持续保持贸易顺差，主要依靠劳动密集型和资源型出口，而美国在资本和技术密集型产品占主导。COVID-19冲击短暂影响贸易量，但恢复迅速，双边贸易结构具有韧性和战略重要性。
AI.research_question: 2012-2022年期间印美贸易关系的发展趋势如何？COVID-19大流行对双边贸易产生了什么影响？印美贸易的结构特征和互补性体现在哪些方面？
AI.motivation: 理解印美贸易关系的长期动态和结构特征，评估全球性冲击（特别是COVID-19）对双边贸易的影响，分析两国贸易互补性和战略意义，为政策制定提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易理论（比较优势理论）、贸易互补性理论、全球价值链理论、冲击与恢复理论、结构韧性理论。
AI.method: 使用官方政府数据和定量分析框架，将研究期分为COVID前（2012-2019）和COVID后（2019-2022）两个阶段，分析出口、进口和贸易平衡趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 印度持续保持贸易顺差；2. 印度优势在劳动密集型和资源型出口（纺织品、药品）；3. 美国优势在资本和技术密集型产品；4. COVID-19冲击在2020年短暂减少贸易量；5. 2021-2022年贸易快速恢复并呈现多样化趋势；6. 双边贸易具有结构韧性和战略重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了印美贸易的互补性理论；2. 提供了全球性冲击下贸易韧性的实证证据；3. 发展了长期贸易动态分析框架；4. 丰富了新兴市场与发达国家贸易关系的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供贸易决策依据；2. 帮助企业了解贸易机会和风险；3. 支持印美战略伙伴关系发展；4. 为全球供应链调整提供参考；5. 促进双边贸易平衡和多样化发展。
