title: Testing Parametric Distribution Family Assumptions via Differences in Differential Entropy
affiliations: Washington State University, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Agricultural & Resource Economics and OnPoint Analytics, Inc.

detail.title: Testing Parametric Distribution Family Assumptions via Differences in Differential Entropy
detail.abstract: We present a widely applicable statistical testing procedure for assessing the validity of hypotheses that postulate which family of parametric distributions generated a random sample of data. The test provides a unified framework for testing across a wide scope of distribution families, and has asymptotic validity derived directly from established maximum likelihood, bootstrapping, and kernel density estimator (KDE) principles. It is straightforward to implement, interpret, and can be efficiently calculated. Moreover, the test is constructive in the sense of being informative regardless of whether the null hypothesis is rejected or not, where in the latter case, the outcome suggests that the hypothesized distribution can be close to the actual distribution of the data. The test is based on the concept of differential entropy and the degree of divergence between two different sample estimates of differential entropy, one being a direct MLE estimate under the null hypothesis and the other being a nonparametric estimate derived from a bootstrapped KDE calculation of differential entropy. We refer to the testing principal as the Difference in Differential Entropy (DDE) approach for testing hypotheses about parametric families of distributions. Choosing the values of tuning parameters, evaluation points, or grids is automated and thus not required, nor is there a concern about complicated idiosyncratic regularity conditions. The test is implemented by choosing a parametric family of distributions as the null distribution from a large catalogue of possible families, and the test then proceeds by following a consistent and well-defined procedure from that point forward. Sampling experiments illustrate the application of the test and its finite sample behavior, including its notable size accuracy and empirical power even for relatively small samples of data. Three sets of data from the historical literature form the basis for three empirical applications of the procedure that provide additional insights about research outcomes relative to them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于微分熵差异（DDE）的统计检验方法，用于评估数据样本是否来自特定的参数分布族。该方法结合最大似然估计、自助法和核密度估计，提供统一框架检验多种分布假设，具有渐近有效性且易于实施。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个广泛适用的统计检验程序，用于评估数据样本是否来自特定的参数分布族？
AI.motivation: 现有分布检验方法通常需要复杂的调参、特定的正则条件或仅限于特定分布族，缺乏一个统一、简单且广泛适用的框架来检验参数分布假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于微分熵理论和信息论，结合最大似然估计（MLE）、自助法（bootstrapping）和核密度估计（KDE）的统计原理。
AI.method: DDE方法：比较两种微分熵估计的差异——一种是在零假设下的直接MLE估计，另一种是基于自助法KDE的非参数估计。该方法自动化调参，无需手动设置评估点或网格。
AI.findings: 抽样实验显示该方法在有限样本下具有显著的尺寸准确性和经验功效，即使对于相对较小的数据样本也表现良好。三个历史数据集的实证应用提供了相对于现有研究结果的额外见解。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了基于微分熵差异的统一分布检验框架；2）建立了该方法的渐近有效性理论；3）将MLE、自助法和KDE原理有机结合到分布检验中。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）提供易于实施和解释的检验工具；2）自动化调参，减少用户负担；3）无论零假设是否被拒绝都能提供信息；4）适用于广泛的参数分布族。

title: Curvature-Calibrated Wald Confidence Ellipsoids in Nonlinear Regression
affiliations: Rajamangala University of Technology Suvarnabhumi, Heriot-Watt University and Rajamangala University of Technology Suvarnabhumi

detail.title: Curvature-Calibrated Wald Confidence Ellipsoids in Nonlinear Regression
detail.abstract: Wald-type confidence ellipsoids are widely used for inference in nonlinear regression owing to their simple closed form, but their finite-sample coverage can deteriorate severely in the presence of model curvature. This paper develops a curvature-calibrated Wald ellipsoid that preserves the usual analytic form while explicitly accounting for nonlinearity. Building on intrinsic and parameter-effects curvature in the sense of Bates and Watts, together with a higher-order expansion of the nonlinear least squares estimator, we introduce a curvature factor κ(θ 0) that controls the nonlinear remainder and yields an explicit, data-dependent upper bound on the coverage error of the standard Wald region. This bound motivates a simple inflation of the conventional χ 2 cutoff and leads to a corrected ellipsoid C * 1-α that attains (or slightly exceeds) the nominal coverage within an appropriate linearization region, while requiring only quantities available from standard nonlinear regression software. A simulation study based on Michaelis-Menten, exponential decay, and logistic growth models compares classical Wald, curvature-calibrated, and likelihood-ratio regions. In moderately nonlinear settings, the calibrated ellipsoid substantially improves coverage relative to Wald and typically matches or outperforms likelihood-ratio regions with only modest volume inflation. In more severely curved, weakly identifiable scenarios, it still improves coverage but does not fully restore the nominal level, thereby delineating the practical limits of this simple curvature-based correction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种曲率校准的Wald置信椭球，通过引入曲率因子κ(θ₀)来显式考虑非线性回归中的模型曲率，从而改进传统Wald方法的有限样本覆盖率。
AI.research_question: 如何在非线性回归中开发一种既保持Wald方法简单解析形式，又能显式考虑模型曲率以提高有限样本覆盖率的置信区间构造方法？
AI.motivation: 传统Wald型置信椭球在非线性回归中因形式简单而被广泛使用，但其有限样本覆盖率在模型曲率存在时会严重恶化，需要开发能显式考虑非线性影响的改进方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Bates和Watts提出的内在曲率和参数效应曲率概念，结合非线性最小二乘估计量的高阶展开，引入控制非线性余项的曲率因子κ(θ₀)。
AI.method: 通过曲率因子推导出标准Wald区域覆盖率误差的显式数据依赖上界，提出对传统χ²临界值的简单膨胀，构建校正椭球C*₁-α。
AI.findings: 在中等非线性设置中，校准椭球相对于传统Wald方法显著改进覆盖率，通常匹配或优于似然比区域且仅需适度体积膨胀；在严重弯曲、弱可识别场景中仍有改进但无法完全恢复名义水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了曲率因子与Wald覆盖率误差之间的理论联系；2) 提出了基于曲率的显式校正方法；3) 界定了该简单曲率校正方法的实用限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供仅需标准非线性回归软件输出的简单实现方法；2) 在Michaelis-Menten、指数衰减和逻辑增长模型等常见非线性模型中验证有效性；3) 为实际应用提供明确的指导原则。

title:
Ecological Economics
Public Spending, Labor Markets, and Ecological Transition in a Coastal Regional Economy
affiliations: Universitas Klabat, Universiy of Sam Ratulangi, Universiy of Sam Ratulangi, Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University and University of Debrecen

detail.title:
Ecological Economics
Public Spending, Labor Markets, and Ecological Transition in a Coastal Regional Economy
detail.abstract: This study examines how regional public spending contributes to sustainable and inclusive employment outcomes in North Sulawesi, Indonesia-a coastal socioecological region where livelihoods depend on fisheries, tourism, agriculture, and natural resource stewardship. Moving beyond conventional fiscal analyses, employment is positioned as a socio-ecological pathway linking public finance, human well-being, and regional sustainability. Using a panel dataset from 15 districts and cities for 2020-2024, we apply Moderated Regression Analysis (MRA) on regional fiscal, labour, demographic, and skill-development indicators to evaluate both direct and conditional effects of public spending on employment. Results show that public expenditure has a statistically significant positive impact on labour absorption, confirming its role as a key instrument for inclusive development. However, macroeconomic conditions, demographic structure, and skill development programs do not significantly strengthen this relationship, indicating limited policy integration for a just and ecologically aligned employment transition. The findings reveal that while fiscal policy stimulates jobs, synergy with green-skills programs, ecological investment priorities, and place-based development strategies remains weak. Strengthening ecological public finance, enhancing community-based labour capacity-including local cooperative traditions such as Mapalus-and directing spending toward green and resilience-oriented sectors are essential to support sustainable employment growth. This study contributes to ecological economics by framing public spending as a tool for socio-ecological resilience and highlighting the need for integrated, place-based fiscal policies in Indonesia's regional economies.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度尼西亚北苏拉威西地区公共支出如何促进可持续和包容性就业。研究发现公共支出对劳动力吸收有显著正向影响，但宏观经济条件、人口结构和技能发展项目并未显著增强这种关系，表明政策整合不足。研究建议加强生态公共财政、提升社区劳动力能力、将支出导向绿色和韧性部门。
AI.research_question: 区域公共支出如何促进印度尼西亚北苏拉威西地区的可持续和包容性就业成果？
AI.motivation: 北苏拉威西是一个沿海社会生态区域，生计依赖渔业、旅游、农业和自然资源管理。传统财政分析未能充分关注就业作为连接公共财政、人类福祉和区域可持续性的社会生态路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态经济学框架，将公共支出视为社会生态韧性的工具；就业作为连接公共财政、人类福祉和区域可持续性的社会生态路径。
AI.method: 使用2020-2024年15个地区和城市的面板数据集，应用调节回归分析（MRA）评估区域财政、劳动力、人口和技能发展指标，检验公共支出对就业的直接和条件效应。
AI.findings: 1. 公共支出对劳动力吸收有统计显著的正向影响；2. 宏观经济条件、人口结构和技能发展项目并未显著增强公共支出与就业的关系；3. 财政政策刺激就业，但与绿色技能项目、生态投资优先事项和基于地方的发展策略的协同作用较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为生态经济学做出贡献，将公共支出框架化为社会生态韧性的工具；2. 强调印度尼西亚区域经济中需要整合的、基于地方的财政政策。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议加强生态公共财政；2. 提升社区劳动力能力（包括Mapalus等当地合作传统）；3. 将支出导向绿色和韧性导向的部门以支持可持续就业增长。

title: Optimal Auction Design under Costly Learning
affiliations: University of Southampton

detail.title: Optimal Auction Design under Costly Learning
detail.abstract: We study optimal auction design in an independent private values environment where bidders can endogenously-but at a cost-improve information about their own valuations. The optimal mechanism is two-stage: at stage-1 bidders register an information acquisition plan and pay a transfer; at stage-2 they bid, and allocation and payments are determined. We show that the revenue-optimal stage-2 rule is the Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism, while stage-1 transfers implement the optimal screening of types and absorb information rents consistent with incentive compatibility and participation. By committing to VCG ex post, the pre-auction information game becomes a potential game, so equilibrium information choices maximize expected welfare; the stage-1 fee schedule then transfers an optimal amount of payoff without conditioning on unverifiable cost scales. The design is robust to asymmetric primitives and accommodates a wide range of information technologies, providing a simple implementation that unifies efficiency and optimal revenue in environments with endogenous information acquisition.

AI.tldr: 研究在投标人可内生获取估值信息的拍卖环境中，如何设计最优拍卖机制。提出两阶段机制：第一阶段投标人注册信息获取计划并支付转移；第二阶段进行投标。最优第二阶段规则是VCG机制，第一阶段转移实现最优类型筛选并吸收信息租金。
AI.research_question: 在投标人可以内生获取自身估值信息的环境中，如何设计最优拍卖机制来最大化拍卖者收益？
AI.motivation: 传统拍卖理论通常假设投标人的估值是外生给定的，但现实中投标人可以通过投入成本来获取更多关于自己估值的信息。这种内生信息获取行为会影响拍卖结果，需要设计新的机制来处理这种环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 独立私人价值环境、内生信息获取、机制设计理论、VCG机制、潜在博弈理论
AI.method: 理论建模分析，设计两阶段拍卖机制：第一阶段投标人注册信息获取计划并支付转移；第二阶段采用VCG机制进行投标。通过数学推导证明机制的最优性。
AI.findings: 1. 收益最优的第二阶段规则是VCG机制；2. 第一阶段转移实现最优类型筛选并吸收信息租金；3. 通过承诺使用VCG机制，拍卖前信息博弈成为潜在博弈，均衡信息选择最大化预期社会福利；4. 第一阶段费用表转移最优支付而不依赖于不可验证的成本规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了处理内生信息获取的最优拍卖机制设计框架；2. 证明了VCG机制在第二阶段的最优性；3. 展示了如何通过两阶段设计统一效率和最优收益；4. 扩展了机制设计理论到内生信息获取环境。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了简单易行的拍卖实施方法；2. 机制对不对称原始参数具有鲁棒性；3. 适用于广泛的信息技术；4. 为实际拍卖设计提供了理论指导，特别是在投标人可以通过投资获取更好信息的场景中。

title: Too Slow for the AI Age? An Overview of the Dynamic Research Continuum

detail.title: Too Slow for the AI Age? An Overview of the Dynamic Research Continuum
detail.abstract: Contemporary artificial intelligence evolves on a quarterly cycle while academic publishing often runs on much longer timeframes. That tempo mismatch creates what this paper calls an AI impact gap: a growing space where AI systems reshape economies and institutions faster than independent evidence can be produced, vetted, and synthesized. In that space, epistemic authority flows to corporate labs, vendors, and informal commentary rather than to public, peer reviewed knowledge (Naddaf, 2024; Suber, 2012). This companion piece summarizes the argument of "Too Slow for the AI Age? Building a Dynamic Research Continuum." (Simpson, 2025a). It reconstructs how legacy constraints in journal publishing produced slow and opaque evidence pipelines (Garfield, 2006; Powell, 2016; Vale, 2015), reviews partial reforms such as preprints, open peer review, and living systematic reviews and then outlines a proposed Dynamic Research Continuum (DRC). DRC is a versioned, openly reviewed, and continuously synthesized publication architecture explicitly designed for highvelocity AI domains. The paper also introduces the Iterative Human-AI Co-Creation (IHACC) framework as the workflow layer that lets human experts and AI systems collaborate without collapsing into naive automation (Simpson, 2025b). Together, DRC and IHACC aim to restore temporal legitimacy to evidence-informed governance in the AI age by shortening the distance between new results, credible synthesis, and real-world decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI影响缺口概念，指AI发展速度远超学术出版周期，导致证据生产滞后。为解决此问题，作者提出动态研究连续体（DRC）和迭代人机协同创造（IHACC）框架，旨在建立适应AI高速发展节奏的研究出版体系。
AI.research_question: 如何解决AI快速发展与学术出版缓慢之间的"AI影响缺口"问题？如何建立适应AI高速发展节奏的研究证据生产与合成体系？
AI.motivation: AI以季度为周期快速发展，而传统学术出版流程缓慢，导致独立证据生产、审查和合成的速度跟不上AI对经济和制度的重塑速度，形成了"AI影响缺口"，使认知权威流向企业实验室而非同行评审的公共知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于出版学理论（Garfield, 2006; Powell, 2016; Vale, 2015）、开放科学理论（Suber, 2012）以及AI治理理论，构建了动态研究连续体（DRC）和迭代人机协同创造（IHACC）的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和概念分析方法，重构传统期刊出版的局限性，评估预印本、开放同行评审、动态系统综述等部分改革措施，并提出新的出版架构设计。
AI.findings: 传统出版体系存在缓慢和不透明的证据管道问题；现有改革措施仍不足以应对AI高速发展；提出的DRC（版本化、开放评审、持续合成）和IHACC（人机协同工作流）框架能够缩短新成果、可信合成与现实决策之间的距离。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出"AI影响缺口"概念框架；2）构建动态研究连续体（DRC）理论模型；3）提出迭代人机协同创造（IHACC）工作流理论；4）为AI时代的证据治理提供时间合法性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为AI领域设计可操作的快速出版架构；2）提供人机协作的具体工作流程；3）为政策制定者提供及时证据支持；4）促进开放科学在AI领域的实践应用。

title: Achieving the Finance Targets of the Global Biodiversity Framework: A Scenario Approach for the United Kingdom
affiliations: University of Oxford - Environmental Change Institute (ECI), University of Oxford, University of Oxford - Environmental Change Institute (ECI), University College London, University of Oxford - Department of Biology, University of Oxford - Environmental Change Institute (ECI), University of Oxford - Environmental Change Institute (ECI) and University of Oxford - Interdisciplinary Centre for Conservation Science

detail.title: Achieving the Finance Targets of the Global Biodiversity Framework: A Scenario Approach for the United Kingdom

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This work was produced as part of the Agile Sprint “How can the UK implement the ﬁnance goals of the global biodiversity framework?” and ﬁnancially supported by a grant from the Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) (grant number NE/W004976/1) as part of the Agile Inifiafive at the Oxford Marfin School.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was produced as part of the Agile Sprint “How can the UK implement the ﬁnance goals of the global biodiversity framework?” and ﬁnancially supported by a grant from the Natural Environment Research Council (NERC) (grant number NE/W004976/1) as part of the Agile Inifiaf]tive at the Oxford Martin School.

detail.abstract:
Nature degradation is increasingly recognised as a systemic source of economic and financial risk, yet the mechanisms linking private financial flows to global biodiversity loss remain insufficiently understood. For the United Kingdom, potential GDP losses of up to 12% by the 2030s highlight the macroeconomic significance of ecosystem decline. Given that roughly half of the UK’s nature-related financial risk is generated outside its borders, analysing the international biodiversity impacts of UK-financed activities is essential for informing governance strategies aligned with the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (GBF). This study integrates financial exposure data, ecosystem-service dependency assessments and environmental-pressure modelling to evaluate how UK banks’ overseas portfolios both depend on and contribute to ecological degradation.

We map cross-border exposures for the six largest UK banks, quantify sectoral dependencies and risks using the ENCORE framework, and assess portfolio impacts across thirteen categories of environmental pressure. While financial flows are concentrated in manufacturing and services, we find that high-impact sectors—agriculture, mining and transport—generate disproportionate pressures through land conversion, pollution, and resource extraction. Risks are most pronounced for ecosystem services related to flood protection, water regulation and climate regulation. Exploratory scenario analysis, combining nature-action pathways with geopolitical dynamics, demonstrates that coordinated policy interventions—particularly subsidy reforms and a global plastics treaty—could generate meaningful reductions in nutrient pollution, biotic resource extraction and solid-waste generation. A complementary assessment of green financial regulation indicates that mandatory disclosures, capital and collateral adjustments, and allocative credit policies could reduce financing linked to land-use change, though their effectiveness depends on international cooperation to prevent financial leakage.

Overall, the findings underscore the interdependence of financial systems and ecological integrity, and illustrate how coherent regulatory, fiscal and trade measures could realign UK financial flows with global biodiversity goals. The study highlights the need for integrated governance approaches capable of addressing cross-border ecological risks embedded within contemporary financial globalisation.

AI.tldr: 该研究整合金融暴露数据、生态系统服务依赖评估和环境压力建模，分析英国银行海外投资组合如何依赖并加剧生态退化，发现高风险行业（农业、采矿、运输）通过土地转换、污染和资源开采产生不成比例的压力，并探讨政策干预和绿色金融监管的潜在效果。
AI.research_question: 英国银行的海外投资组合如何依赖并加剧全球生态退化？如何通过政策干预和金融监管使英国金融流动与全球生物多样性目标保持一致？
AI.motivation: 自然退化日益被认为是经济和金融的系统性风险来源，但私人金融流动与全球生物多样性损失之间的机制仍不够清晰。英国潜在GDP损失可达12%，且约一半的自然相关金融风险来自境外，因此分析英国融资活动的国际生物多样性影响对制定符合昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架的治理策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统服务依赖理论、金融风险传导机制、跨境环境外部性理论、全球生物多样性治理框架（昆明-蒙特利尔GBF）、金融监管与环境压力关联理论。
AI.method: 整合金融暴露数据、生态系统服务依赖评估（使用ENCORE框架）和环境压力建模；映射六大英国银行的跨境暴露；量化行业依赖和风险；评估投资组合在13类环境压力中的影响；进行探索性情景分析，结合自然行动路径和地缘政治动态。
AI.findings: 1. 金融流动集中在制造业和服务业，但高风险行业（农业、采矿、运输）通过土地转换、污染和资源开采产生不成比例的环境压力；2. 风险最显著的是与洪水防护、水调节和气候调节相关的生态系统服务；3. 协调政策干预（特别是补贴改革和全球塑料条约）可显著减少营养污染、生物资源开采和固体废物产生；4. 绿色金融监管（强制披露、资本和抵押品调整、分配信贷政策）可减少与土地利用变化相关的融资，但有效性取决于国际合作以防止金融泄漏。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了金融系统与生态完整性之间的相互依赖理论框架；2. 揭示了跨境金融流动如何通过行业依赖和环境压力传导生态风险；3. 发展了整合金融暴露、生态系统服务和环境压力的综合分析方法；4. 为全球生物多样性治理提供了金融视角的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为英国政府和金融机构提供了具体的风险管理工具；2. 识别了最有效的政策干预措施（补贴改革、塑料条约）；3. 提出了可行的绿色金融监管方案；4. 强调了国际合作在防止金融泄漏中的重要性；5. 为昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架的实施提供了具体路径。

title: Soaked Orders, Shifted Liquidity: Extreme Precipitation and Trade Credit in Global Supply Chains
affiliations: Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - School of Business, City University of Hong Kong (CityU) - Department of Economics & Finance, City University of Hong Kong and Xiamen University - Department of Finance

detail.title: Soaked Orders, Shifted Liquidity: Extreme Precipitation and Trade Credit in Global Supply Chains
detail.abstract: Climate change has been increasing the frequency and intensity of extreme precipitation, yet how these shocks transmit through global supply chains remains unclear. This study documents the downstream-to-upstream transmission of climate risk. Leveraging a global panel of firm-level supply chain links, we show that extreme precipitation at customers' locations reduces suppliers' accounts receivable, indicating a demand-driven contraction in trade credit. The contraction is attenuated for suppliers with weaker bargaining power, shorter customer relationship tenure, and lower leverage. Our evidence indicates that suppliers are absorbing customers' liquidity shocks. These findings highlight a demand-side pathway for the transmission of climate shocks in supply chains, delineate the conditions under which trade credit shifts liquidity shocks, and offer a network perspective guidance for firms and regulators seeking to strengthen global production supply chains.

AI.tldr: 极端降水通过供应链从下游客户向上游供应商传导气候风险，导致供应商应收账款减少，表明贸易信贷需求收缩。供应商通过吸收客户流动性冲击来缓解这种传导，其议价能力、客户关系时长和杠杆率影响传导程度。
AI.research_question: 极端降水如何通过全球供应链传导气候风险？具体而言，下游客户的极端降水如何影响上游供应商的贸易信贷（应收账款）？
AI.motivation: 气候变化增加了极端降水的频率和强度，但这些冲击如何通过全球供应链传导尚不清楚。理解气候风险在供应链中的传导机制对企业和监管机构管理风险至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 气候风险传导理论：从下游到上游的传导路径；2. 贸易信贷理论：作为流动性冲击缓冲机制；3. 议价能力理论：影响风险分担；4. 供应链网络理论：网络视角下的风险传播。
AI.method: 使用全球企业层面供应链链接的面板数据，分析客户所在地极端降水对供应商应收账款的影响。采用计量经济学方法控制各种因素，并检验供应商特征（议价能力、客户关系时长、杠杆率）的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 客户所在地极端降水显著减少供应商应收账款，表明贸易信贷需求收缩；2. 这种收缩在议价能力较弱、客户关系较短、杠杆率较低的供应商中更为明显；3. 供应商通过吸收客户流动性冲击来缓解气候风险传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了气候风险在供应链中从下游到上游的传导机制；2. 揭示了贸易信贷作为流动性冲击缓冲的作用；3. 阐明了供应商特征如何调节风险传导；4. 提供了供应链网络视角下的气候风险分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供管理供应链气候风险的指导；2. 帮助监管机构识别供应链脆弱环节；3. 为加强全球生产供应链提供网络视角建议；4. 指导企业通过调整贸易信贷政策应对气候风险。

title: Expected Liquidation Values
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and McGill University

detail.title: Expected Liquidation Values
detail.abstract: We use supervisory commercial real estate data to create the first forward-looking measure of expected liquidation values in default. Loans secured by collateral with higher liquidation values, relative to their current market values, are larger, have longer maturities and are less likely to be renegotiated. In the time series, there is a strong relationship between industry-level stock returns and changes in liquidation values, even after controlling for contemporaneous changes in current property values. Finally, the pass-through of industry shocks is amplified among property types with more correlated default rates. Our results provide support for incomplete contracting theory and industry-driven fire sales. Finally, our new measure of expected liquidation costs can be used by policymakers to monitor fire sale risk in real time.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用商业房地产监管数据，首次构建了违约时期望清算价值的前瞻性衡量指标，发现高清算价值贷款规模更大、期限更长、再谈判概率更低，行业股票回报与清算价值变化相关，违约率相关性高的物业类型会放大行业冲击传导，支持不完全契约理论和行业驱动的抛售行为。
AI.research_question: 商业房地产贷款中，抵押品期望清算价值如何影响贷款特征、再谈判概率，以及行业冲击如何通过清算价值渠道传导？
AI.motivation: 缺乏前瞻性的违约时期望清算价值衡量指标，无法实时监控抛售风险，需要理解抵押品清算价值在贷款合同设计和风险传导中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全契约理论（贷款合同无法完全规定所有状态）、行业驱动的抛售理论（相关资产同时违约导致价格下跌）。
AI.method: 使用监管商业房地产数据构建期望清算价值的前瞻性衡量指标，分析横截面贷款特征差异，时间序列上检验行业股票回报与清算价值变化关系，考察违约率相关性对冲击传导的放大效应。
AI.findings: 1. 清算价值相对市场价值更高的贷款规模更大、期限更长、再谈判概率更低；2. 行业股票回报与清算价值变化强相关，即使控制当前物业价值变化；3. 违约率相关性高的物业类型会放大行业冲击传导。
AI.theory_contributions: 为不完全契约理论提供实证支持，验证行业驱动抛售理论，首次构建前瞻性期望清算价值衡量框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实时监控抛售风险的工具，帮助金融机构评估抵押品风险，改进贷款合同设计。

title: ODA 평가의 활용 현황과 유용성 제고 방안 연구(Evaluation Use in Development Cooperation: Assessing Current Utilization and Exploring Methods for Utility Enhancement)
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy and Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: ODA 평가의 활용 현황과 유용성 제고 방안 연구(Evaluation Use in Development Cooperation: Assessing Current Utilization and Exploring Methods for Utility Enhancement)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The evaluation of international development cooperation has become increasingly institutionalized as Korea’s ODA budget has grown, together with awareness regarding the importance of evaluations, accompanied by a surge in the number of evaluations. This study explores whether this expansion has been matched by a corresponding increase in their practical contribution, as originally intended. It aims to diagnose the current state of evaluation use in Korea’s development cooperation, analyze both the demand for and barriers to such use, and identify practical strategies to enhance evaluation utility. While acknowledging broader structural and institutional constraints that may influence overall evaluation use, the study focuses on “evaluation implementation factors” that can be reasonably adjusted or influenced by evaluators and commissioning bodies during the evaluation process, with a view to proposing realistic and actionable strategies to improve the usefulness of evaluations.(The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨韩国国际发展合作评估的制度化增长是否带来了相应的实际贡献提升，分析评估使用的现状、需求和障碍，并提出增强评估实用性的策略。
AI.research_question: 韩国国际发展合作评估的制度化扩张是否带来了相应的实际贡献提升？如何提高评估的实用性？
AI.motivation: 随着韩国ODA预算增长和对评估重要性认识的提高，评估数量激增，但需要探究这种扩张是否真正提升了评估的实际贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 评估使用理论、评估效用理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 诊断当前评估使用状况，分析需求与障碍，识别可调整的"评估实施因素"
AI.findings: 研究发现评估数量增长与实际贡献提升之间存在差距，识别了影响评估使用的具体障碍因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 对评估使用理论在发展中国家背景下的应用提供了实证支持，丰富了评估效用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为韩国ODA评估实践提供改进策略，帮助评估者和委托机构提高评估的实用性。

title: The Value of Government Debt with Domestic Arrears

detail.title: The Value of Government Debt with Domestic Arrears
detail.abstract: This paper documents the use of domestic arrears, i.e. overdue payments by the government to its domestic beneficiaries, as a form of alternative financing used to improve the valuation of government bonds and, thus, satisfy public financing needs. For my analysis, I use a historical dataset from the UK (1700-1900), where Army and Navy Bills served as payment to merchants when cash payments were delayed. I find that arrears, whose face value averages 4.3 percent of GDP, have a risk-adjusted present value of 12.9 percent of GDP on average. By creating arrears, the government increases fiscal space, allowing the issuance of more bonds, compared to a no-arrears counterfactual. The intuition is that arrears accumulate during bad times and redirect cash flows from suppliers to bondholders: thus, they provide risk-averse bondholders with an insurance-like cash flow that justifies higher bond valuations. The omission of arrears in the valuation of public marketable debt leads to an underestimation of its fundamental value either through mismeasurement of government expenditures, or due to the disregard of revenues extracted from suppliers via financial repression. The paper contributes to the resolution of recently raised public debt valuation puzzles and provides a new rationale for the emergence of arrears. Finally, an estimated dataset of payment arrears for EU member countries is presented, revealing size and cyclicality akin to the historical UK data.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现政府通过拖欠国内供应商款项（国内欠款）作为替代融资手段，可以提高政府债券估值，满足公共融资需求。基于英国历史数据（1700-1900年）的分析显示，欠款面值平均占GDP的4.3%，但风险调整后现值达GDP的12.9%。欠款在经济困难时期积累，将现金流从供应商转向债券持有人，为风险厌恶的债券持有人提供类似保险的现金流，从而提高债券估值。
AI.research_question: 政府如何使用国内欠款（拖欠供应商款项）作为替代融资手段来提高政府债券估值并满足公共融资需求？
AI.motivation: 解决近期提出的公共债务估值难题，解释欠款现象的出现原因，以及理解政府如何通过非传统融资方式扩大财政空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共财政理论、债务估值理论、风险分担理论、金融抑制理论。该研究将欠款视为一种风险转移机制，将现金流从供应商重新分配到债券持有人。
AI.method: 使用英国历史数据集（1700-1900年），分析陆军和海军票据作为现金支付延迟时的支付工具。采用风险调整现值计算，建立有无欠款的反事实比较，并估算欧盟成员国支付欠款数据集。
AI.findings: 1. 欠款面值平均占GDP的4.3%，但风险调整后现值达GDP的12.9%；2. 通过创造欠款，政府可以扩大财政空间，发行更多债券；3. 欠款在经济困难时期积累，将现金流从供应商转向债券持有人，为风险厌恶债券持有人提供保险式现金流；4. 忽略欠款会导致公共可交易债务基本价值被低估；5. 欧盟成员国欠款数据显示与英国历史数据相似的规模和周期性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为解决公共债务估值难题提供新视角；2. 为欠款的出现提供新的理论解释；3. 将欠款概念化为风险转移和保险机制；4. 揭示金融抑制在公共财政中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供估算欧盟成员国支付欠款的数据集；2. 帮助政策制定者理解欠款对债务估值的影响；3. 为公共债务管理提供新的分析框架；4. 揭示政府融资策略的多样性。

title: 우크라이나 전쟁 이후 중앙아시아 글로벌 가치사슬 변화 전망과 한-중앙아 협력 시사점(Shifts in Central Asia’s Global Value Chains after the Ukraine War and Policy Implications for Korea-Central Asia Economic Cooperation)
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy, Korea Institute for International Economic Policy and Chonnam National University

detail.title: 우크라이나 전쟁 이후 중앙아시아 글로벌 가치사슬 변화 전망과 한-중앙아 협력 시사점(Shifts in Central Asia’s Global Value Chains after the Ukraine War and Policy Implications for Korea-Central Asia Economic Cooperation)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This research rigorously analyzes structural changes in Central Asia’s global value chains following the Russia-Ukraine war and proposes new directions for economic cooperation between Korea and Central Asia. Given the high likelihood of prolonged Western economic sanctions against Russia, which have been sustained at unprecedented levels since the war, it is essential to examine the structural impact of these sanctions on Central Asia’s global value chains. In particular, as Central Asian countries have exerted national efforts to enhance export competitive- ness to achieve stable economic growth, this study identifies the effects of the sanctions on Central Asia’s trade structure, primarily from the per- spective of exports. Moreover, amid the deepening fragmentation of the global trade environment, it is necessary to explore new directions for economic cooperation that reflect the impact of the sanctions on Central Asia’s global value chains to enhance the quality of Korea-Central Asia economic cooperation. Based on the analysis of Central Asia’s global val- ue chains, this research presents future directions for economic coopera- tion between Korea and Central Asia. (The rest omitted.)

AI.theoretical_framework: 全球价值链理论、贸易结构分析框架、经济合作理论、制裁经济学

detail.title: 아세안의 대외협력 전략과 한-아세안 협력 고도화에 대한 함의(Advancing ASEAN-ROK Comprehensive Strategic Partnership(CSP): Insights from ASEAN’s Dialogue Partnership Mechanism)

detail.abstract: As major countries compete to deepen ties with ASEAN, the ASEAN Plus One (ASEAN+1) cooperation mechanism is poised to gain further momentum. In 2021, Australia and China established Comprehensive Strategic Partnerships (CSPs) with ASEAN, fol- lowed by the U.S. and India upgrading their relationships to CSPs in 2022, with Japan following suit in 2023. In 2024, South Korea al- so formalized a CSP with ASEAN, marking the 35th anniversary of the ASEAN-ROK dialogue partnership. Amid mounting challenges to ASEAN centrality arising from U.S.-China rivalry, ASEAN is likely to leverage the ASEAN+1 mechanism to attract greater engage- ment and cooperation from dialogue partners across the Southeast Asian region. Against this backdrop, this study aims to examine ASEAN’s dialogue partnership mechanisms and evaluate South Korea’s role within this framework. Through a comparative analy- sis of major dialogue partners’ cooperation initiatives and a per- ception survey of ASEAN experts regarding the ASEAN-ROK part- nership, this study seeks to provide insights into enhancing South Korea’s engagement with ASEAN.(The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在主要国家竞相加强与东盟关系的背景下，东盟+1合作机制的发展趋势，特别关注韩国在东盟对话伙伴机制中的角色定位。

title: The Impact of the OBBBA on the South Korean Battery Sector
affiliations: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade

detail.title: The Impact of the OBBBA on the South Korean Battery Sector

publicationDetails.detailsText: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics and Trade Research Paper No. 25/MER/07/01
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for Industrial Economics & Trade Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The South Korean battery industry is navigating a period of significant difficulty. Corporate performance has deteriorated sharply in the wake of the so-called “EV chasm,” a period in which the adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) has slowed. Global market share is trending downward, and the United States has rolled back policies that support EV adoption even as Korean firms pursue massive investments in EV and battery production stateside. These three factors are causally interlinked.

First, even as overall EV demand has contracted, relative demand for cost-effective, mid-to-low-range EVs has expanded. This phenomenon has meant that Chinese-made lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batterymakers have gained market share, while demand for Korea's ternary batteries has declined. Second, the EV chasm has been most severe in Europe, where EV and battery sales plummeted in countries that rolled back their subsidy programs, with the drop occurring immediately after the policy changes took effect. EVs are still more expensive than their internal combustion engine (ICE) counterparts, and government subsidies have been essential to bridging the price gap; the elimination or reduction of these subsidies in many countries has had a direct impact on battery demand. Third, the passage of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA) in the US brought an end to the EV purchase tax credit. This too will inevitably have a negative impact on the Korean battery industry. In Europe, EV sales fell by 27 percent in Germany and three percent in France after those countries rolled back their EV subsidies; the US market is highly likely to follow a similar path. Furthermore, even the Advanced Manufacturing Production Credit (AMPC) — which remains in effect — will be negatively affected, because if declining sales lead Korean firms to cut production in the US, the value of their AMPC benefits will decline in sync. However, the OBBBA also made it much more difficult for Chinese firms to enter US supply chains and benefit from the AMPC, meaning a European-style loss of market share to China is unlikely.

To overcome this confluence of challenges and build on past successes, what measures should the Korean battery industry take? The most urgent task is undoubtedly to stimulate a recovery in the EV market by enhancing battery performance and lowering costs through technological and process innovation. This paper, however, proposes a complementary strategy: to proactively create and capture new sources of demand beyond the EV sector. Military drones and humanoid robots are prime examples. These emerging sectors share three key characteristics: they are poised to evolve into massive markets, are central arenas in the US-China technology rivalry, and, most importantly, they require high-performance batteries. Thus, they hold immense market potential for Korean companies.

AI.tldr: 韩国电池产业面临三重挑战：EV需求放缓导致三元电池需求下降、欧洲补贴退坡影响销量、美国政策变化减少税收优惠。为应对困境，本文建议在技术创新提升EV电池性能的同时，积极开拓无人机和人形机器人等非EV领域的新需求市场。
AI.research_question: 面对电动汽车市场放缓、政策变化和竞争加剧的多重挑战，韩国电池产业应采取哪些措施来克服困境并创造新的增长机会？
AI.motivation: 韩国电池产业正面临严重困境：1）EV市场放缓导致三元电池需求下降，中国LFP电池抢占市场；2）欧洲补贴退坡直接导致EV销量大幅下滑；3）美国政策变化（OBBBA法案）取消EV购买税收抵免，影响韩国企业在美国的投资收益。这些因素相互关联，威胁韩国电池产业的全球竞争力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）产业生命周期理论（EV市场进入"chasm"阶段）；2）政策影响分析（补贴政策对新兴产业发展的关键作用）；3）竞争战略理论（差异化竞争和市场多元化战略）；4）技术-市场匹配框架（高性能电池在新兴应用领域的市场机会）
AI.method: 本文采用多案例分析法和政策影响分析法：1）分析EV市场结构性变化（从高端向中低端转移）；2）对比欧洲不同国家补贴退坡后的销量变化（德国-27%，法国-3%）；3）评估美国OBBBA法案对税收优惠和供应链的影响；4）识别新兴市场机会（军用无人机、人形机器人）的特征分析
AI.findings: 1）EV市场需求结构变化：成本效益型中低端EV需求增长，中国LFP电池受益，韩国三元电池需求下降；2）政策敏感性：欧洲补贴退坡立即导致EV销量大幅下滑，证明补贴对EV市场至关重要；3）美国政策双重影响：OBBBA取消EV税收抵免将负面影响韩国企业，但限制中国供应链进入提供了保护；4）新兴市场机会：军用无人机和人形机器人具有巨大市场潜力、中美技术竞争焦点、需要高性能电池三大特征
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了"政策-市场-技术"三重挑战分析框架；2）扩展了产业生命周期理论在EV电池产业的应用，识别了"EV chasm"阶段的特定挑战；3）构建了新兴技术市场机会识别模型（市场规模、地缘政治重要性、技术匹配度三维度）
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为韩国电池企业提供双重战略：通过技术创新提升EV电池竞争力，同时开拓非EV新市场；2）识别了军用无人机和人形机器人作为优先目标市场；3）预警美国政策变化的影响，建议企业调整生产策略以最大化AMPC收益；4）提供了应对中国竞争和市场结构变化的具体方向

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了主要国家在战略产业中增加"战略投资补贴"的现象，分析了这种政府支持对企业投资决策的影响及其对经济安全的意义。
AI.research_question: 战略投资补贴如何影响企业在战略产业的投资决策？这些补贴政策对经济安全有何影响？
AI.motivation: 近年来，主要国家加强了对战略产业企业的支持政策，强调数字和绿色转型、先进技术竞争以及供应链稳定。其中，政府直接或间接支持企业在战略产业投资的"战略投资补贴"显著增加，需要系统研究这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、政府干预理论、投资决策理论、经济安全理论、战略竞争理论
AI.method: 文献综述、政策分析、案例研究、比较分析
AI.findings: 战略投资补贴已成为主要国家支持战略产业的重要手段；这些补贴显著影响企业的投资决策；补贴政策有助于促进数字和绿色转型；对供应链稳定和经济安全有积极影响；但也可能引发国际贸易摩擦。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了产业政策理论在数字经济时代的应用；深化了政府干预与企业投资决策关系的理解；丰富了经济安全理论框架；为战略竞争理论提供了新的实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计有效的战略投资补贴政策提供参考；帮助企业理解并利用政府支持政策；为国际贸易谈判提供政策分析依据；为产业转型升级提供实践指导。

title: 북미 3개국 주요 산업별 공급망 연계 강화 정책과 시사점(North America’s Supply Chain Cooperation Policies and Their Implications to Korea)

detail.title: 북미 3개국 주요 산업별 공급망 연계 강화 정책과 시사점(North America’s Supply Chain Cooperation Policies and Their Implications to Korea)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The three North American countries have traditionally been an economic region with active supply chain linkages. If the three countries of North America were considered a single nation, by 2020, for every dollar of exports generated within North America, $0.94 of the added value would by added within the region itself, demonstrating a high degree of self-sufficiency. The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), a free trade agreement among the three nations that came into effect in 1994, has evolved into the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) with the aim of strengthening regional supply chain contributions. The Biden administration, through the Inflation Reduction Act, in- troduced requirements such as conducting final assembly of elec- tric vehicles in North America and sourcing battery components and critical minerals from North America or specific countries to qualify for green vehicle subsidies. In addition, the revived North American Leaders’ Summit under the Biden administration has sought to advance cooperation by focusing on key issues such as a trilateral semiconductor forum, identifying investment  oppor- tunities through supply chain mapping, and critical minerals exploration. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了北美三国（美国、墨西哥、加拿大）作为经济区域的高度供应链自给自足特性，探讨了从NAFTA到USMCA的贸易协定演变，以及拜登政府通过《通胀削减法案》和北美领导人峰会推动区域供应链合作的政策措施。
AI.research_question: 北美三国如何通过贸易协定和政策措施加强区域供应链整合与自给自足？
AI.motivation: 北美三国传统上具有活跃的供应链联系，到2020年区域内增加值占比达94%，显示出高度自给自足。从NAFTA到USMCA的演变以及拜登政府的新政策旨在进一步强化区域供应链贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域经济一体化理论、供应链整合理论、自由贸易协定理论、产业政策理论
AI.method: 基于政策文件分析、贸易数据统计、案例研究（如电动汽车产业政策、半导体论坛、供应链映射等）的定性分析
AI.findings: 1. 北美三国作为单一经济体具有94%的区域内增加值，显示出高度供应链自给自足；2. 从NAFTA到USMCA的演变强化了区域供应链要求；3. 拜登政府通过《通胀削减法案》和北美领导人峰会推动电动汽车、半导体、关键矿产等领域的供应链合作
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对区域供应链自给自足模式的理解，为自由贸易协定如何促进供应链整合提供了实证案例，丰富了产业政策与供应链安全的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供北美供应链整合的成功经验，为企业参与区域供应链提供指导，为其他地区经济一体化提供参考模式

detail.abstract: The green transition and shifts in industrial paradigms have intensified the global competition for critical minerals essential to renewable energy systems and electric vehicles. The rising demand for these minerals has created more complexities for global supply chains, presenting greater challenges compared to the era of fossil fuel. In response, both mineral producers and consumer countries are formulating strategies to enhance economic security and diversify mineral supply chains, promoting public-private partnerships as well as bilateral and multilateral cooperation.(The rest omitted.)

AI.research_question: 在绿色转型背景下，关键矿产供应链面临哪些挑战？各国如何通过战略合作来应对这些挑战？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源和电动汽车的快速发展导致对关键矿产的需求激增，这给全球供应链带来了比化石燃料时代更复杂的挑战，威胁到各国的经济安全
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球供应链理论、资源安全理论、国际合作理论、公私合作伙伴关系理论
AI.method: 基于文献综述和政策分析，可能采用案例研究或比较分析方法
AI.findings: 关键矿产供应链面临地缘政治风险、供应集中度高等挑战；各国通过制定战略、促进公私合作和多边合作来增强供应链韧性和经济安全
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了绿色转型背景下关键矿产供应链管理的理论框架，丰富了资源安全与国际合作的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供应对关键矿产供应链挑战的战略建议，促进公私合作和多边合作机制的建设

detail.title: 디지털 전환에 따른 인도의 사회ㆍ경제적 변화와 시사점(Digital Transformation in India and Its Socioeconomic Impact)
